ACC Network: ACC Network Availability

Do all ACC campuses carry ACCN?

Campuses served by an affiliated provider do have access to ACCN.

Does ACCN have an internship program?

ACC students will have the chance to apply for ESPN internships. Production opportunities also exist across all 15 schools to work on ESPN telecasts as part of the school control room project.

How can I get ACC Network Extra (ACCNX)?

  1. Download or open the ESPN Appon your phone, tablet, or smart TV.
  2. Go to the “Browse” or “Channels” tab and select ACC Network Extra.
  3. Log in with your TV provider (cable or streaming service) credentials. Once verified, you will have access to the games.

How do I get the digital part of the Network?

Provided you are a customer who receives ACCN from your pay TV provider, you will have access to ACCNX via the ESPN App.

How will this impact my cable bill?

ESPN negotiates wholesale rates, and retail prices are determined by each distributor. Services like the ACC Network add tremendous value, and given the popularity of ACC programming, the network will have broad distribution.

I live in [state outside ACC footprint]. Are you working to make sure we are able to see the ACCN too?

Yes. Our interest is in delivering this content in broadly distributed packages across the country.

Will I be able to watch ACCN on my mobile phone or similar device?

Yes. ACCN will be available via the ESPN App on computers, tablets, mobile phones and TV-connected devices.

ACC Network: ACC Network General / Structural

Does each campus (or the ACC Offices) have upgraded television facilities?

Each campus has created or upgraded dedicated production facilities for ACCN content.

How is this different than other conference or single-school networks?

This collaboration between the ACC and ESPN will bring together unparalleled content from one of the most competitive conferences in the country, with the highest quality, most innovative production partner in the sports industry.

How many people will work for the ACCN?

We anticipate more than 100 full-time staff for ACCN across ESPN.

What is the Network called?

The Network is called “ACCN.” The formal name is “ACC Network.” ACC Network Extra (ACCNX) is the Network’s digital platform available on the ESPN App.

Where will ACCN be located?

The production home will be in Bristol, Conn., which will provide for efficient use of ESPN’s existing production facilities there—and it will have support from all of ESPN’s resources around the country. ACCN’s business teams will be anchored in Charlotte.

Why is Bristol ACCN’s home, especially since there are no ACC teams in Connecticut?

ESPN already has a state-of-the-art facility in Bristol that, coupled with the individual school studios, can deliver the highest quality content from across the conference.

Will ACCN look similar to ESPN channels?

ACCN will have the highest production quality, consistent with the standard set by ESPN.

ACC Network: ACC Network Programming & Content

Does ACCN air bowl games? ACC Conference Championships?

There are no current plans to air bowl games on the ACCN. ACCN will provide coverage of the ACC Championships for all sports.

Does ACCN include new personalities or use existing ESPN personalities for the games and studio shows?

A mix of both existing ESPN personnel and new on-air staff are present on ACCN. Announcers will always be authentic and familiar to ACC fans.

Does each school have a block of time to program as they see fit?

This is a conference-wide network. The goal is to provide exposure for each of the ACC member institutions. ACCN can achieve this goal without each school having its own block of time to program.

How does ACCN enhance the ACC fan experience?

ACCN brings football, basketball and all ACC-sponsored sports to ACC fans. It provides more in-depth national coverage of all sports that are important to ACC fans, as well as more original content to than ever before. Fans can access live content as well as news and analysis programming on a range of devices.

How many basketball games? Baseball? Women’s sports?

At least 450 events will be televised on ACCN each year. Of the 450 events, there will be more than 150 men’s and women’s basketball games and 200 other regular season competitions and tournament games from across the conference’s 27 sponsored sports. ACCNX will include hundreds of live events and will be available to ACCN subscribers across a range of devices. ACCNX is available via the ESPN App.

Is ACCN available 24 hours a day, seven days a week?

ACCN has 24/7 programming; it’s a dedicated linear and digital platform for all things ACC.

What kind of shows will I see on the ACCN?

ACCN will offer live ACC sports and related studio programming 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Approximately 450 live televised events, including 40 regular season football games, 150 men’s and women’s basketball games, and 200 other regular season competitions and tournament games from across the conference’s 27 sponsored sports will be televised annually, plus a complement of news and information shows and original programming. Together, ACCN’s TV and digital platforms, ACCNE, will feature more than 1,300 ACC events in its first year.

Will there be academic programming?

We will aim to tell stories of the whole athlete, both on and off the field of play.

ESPN Unlimited & Select: Accessing ESPN Content

Casting ESPN Content To Your TV

Casting and Airplay can be accessed through the device management button in the ESPN mobile app header or in the video player.  Note, using Cast or Airplay cannot be done at the same time a StreamCenter session is active.  If you are already connected to StreamCenter, connecting to Cast or Airplay will automatically disconnect the StreamCenter experience.

Closed Captioning Inquiries

ESPN is committed to providing the best quality and experience to all our fans. We strive to stay informed on and adhere to best practices and standards in closed captioning and accessibility for sports programming. Availability may vary by language. For more information, please reach out to: Stephen McDonald, Operations Manager of ESPN Fan Support Email: espn.closedcaptioning@espn.com  Phone: 1-860-766-2000 Address:  ESPN, Inc.  935 Middle Street, Bristol, CT  06010

Closed Captions (CC), Subtitles, and Audio Language Options on ESPN Content

Closed captions are available on most content across ESPN, and you can adjust settings on all supported devices. Select a topic below for more information: - Enabling/disabling captions and subtitles - Formatting closed captions - Finding Spanish-language content

  #### Enabling/disabling captions and subtitles English-language subtitles are available on most English-language videos. Similarly, Spanish-language subtitles are available on most Spanish-language videos. Steps for enabling closed captions may vary a bit by device. On most devices, look for the CC button on the video player bar to toggle them on/off. Please note, Spanish-language subtitles may be burned into some videos and cannot be toggled off. #### Formatting closed captions You can also adjust the appearance of closed captioning on your devices and platforms for your ideal playback experience. The steps to change these settings and the options available will vary depending on the kind of device you’re streaming from. #### Finding Spanish-language content You can usually identify Spanish-language content by the (ESP) designation on the video title. You can also search for Spanish-language videos by searching for “ESP” in the Search bar. On mobile devices, you can also set ESPN Deportes as your preferred edition to find more Spanish-language ESPN+ content: 1. Open the ESPN app and select the Settings gear icon 2. Tap Edition 3. Select U.S. - ESPN Deportes 4. Confirm the selection by tapping Switch to U.S. - ESPN Deportes 5. To switch back, simply follow the above steps then select EE.UU - Inglés as your preferred edition

How can I stream WWE Premium Live Events on ESPN?

ESPN is the new home of WWE Premium Live Events.  Click below link for all the access! Stream WWE Premium Live Events on ESPN | ESPN

How do I watch ESPN+ content in the ESPN App

Access to ESPN+ content is enabled with an active subscription to ESPN Unlimited or ESPN Select. If you do not yet subscribe, click here to get access. #### ESPN App 1. Tap Watch at the bottom of the home page 2. Tap Browse at the top of the next page 3. Scroll down to Channels 4. Select ESPN+ as a channel

Living Room Device (Apple TV, Roku, LG TV, Fire TV Stick, etc.)

  1. Scroll to the far left of the screen
  2. Click on the square with four boxes labeled Browse
  3. Scroll down to the row labeled Channels
  4. Select ESPN+

ESPN.com (Web)

  1. Click Watch in the black menu bar at the top of the screen
  2. Click Browse
  3. Scroll down to the row labeled Channels
  4. Select ESPN+

Is WWE available to stream with ESPN select or unlimited?

2025 WWE events will be available to stream with an ESPN Unlimited plan (standalone or bundled) only.  If you are a current ESPN Select subscriber, you will need to upgrade to an ESPN Unlimited plan to access the WWE events.

What WWE programming can I watch on ESPN?

10 annual WWE Premium Live Events (PLEs), including, but not limited to, iconic tentpoles such as: - Royal Rumble - Elimination Chamber - WrestleMania (two nights) - SummerSlam (two nights) - Money in the Bank - Survivor Series

Live English & Spanish telecast (both with English graphics) On-Demand event replays of PLEs that air on ESPN Live Pre/Post Show for each event (English only) #### Will I need to pay to watch WWE PLEs on ESPN? WWE PLEs will be available to stream with an ESPN Unlimited plan (standalone or bundled) only. If you are a current ESPN Select subscriber, you will need to upgrade to an ESPN Unlimited plan to access the WWE PLEs. Alternatively, if you are a DIRECTV, Fubo TV, Spectrum TV, or Verizon FiOS customer, you may already get ESPN Unlimited as part of your Pay-TV package. To access ESPN Unlimited, you will need to activate your plan and link it to your MyDisney login. Here are instructions on how to do that. If you are a Hulu+ Live TV subscriber, you already have access to ESPN Unlimited through your plan. You’ll just need to log in with your MyDisney credentials. #### What else can I watch with ESPN Unlimited? ESPN Unlimited plan subscribers have access to all ESPN networks and services, including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SECN, ACCN, ESPN+, ESPN on ABC, SECN+, ACCNX, and ESPN3. #### Where, when, and how can I watch Wrestlepalooza 2025? Click here to learn the date, time, channel, card, and how to watch Wrestlepalooza 2025! #### How do I subscribe to ESPN Unlimited? Go to https://stream.espn.com #### Is WWE Network included? Not at this time. #### Where are WWE PLEs on ESPN available? WWE PLEs on ESPN are available in the United States only. Click here for more information on WWE content. #### Will WWE PLEs also be available on Disney+ or Hulu? Yes, for entitled subscribers to an ESPN Unlimited standalone or bundle plan, WWE PLEs will be available on Disney+ and Hulu, in addition to the ESPN App. Customers with access through their Pay TV providers, including Hulu + Live TV, can watch on Disney+ or Hulu after activating their subscription and linking it to their MyDisney login. To watch in the Disney+ app, you will need a Disney+ subscription and an ESPN Unlimited subscription (if you have the Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle, you’re all set!). To watch in the Hulu app, you will need a Hulu subscription and an ESPN Unlimited subscription. Subscribing to the Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle, or Hulu + Live TV (which includes access to ESPN Unlimited) are both great options to watch WWE PLEs in the Hulu app! #### What devices do I need to stream WWE PLEs on ESPN? Click here for a list of all supported devices. #### Is WWE programming available in Spanish? WWE PLEs will be available in both English and Spanish. Note that the Spanish telecast will have English graphics. Pre/Post Shows will only be available in English. #### How can I rewatch an event like Wrestlepalooza? WWE PLEs on ESPN will be available for on-demand replay for subscribers to an ESPN Unlimited plan (standalone or bundled) shortly after the conclusion of each event. #### I get ESPN as part of my cable package. Can I watch Wrestlepalooza that way? Wrestlepalooza will only be available to subscribers of an ESPN Unlimited plan via the ESPN App, (and within Disney+ and Hulu for anyone who subscribes to those services too). Click here to see a full list of Pay TV providers with access to ESPN Unlimited and to learn how to link your subscription. #### I have additional questions about what is available as part of my ESPN subscription. Please click here to visit the ESPN DTC Press Kit.

ESPN Unlimited & Select: Account & Billing

Cancelling Your ESPN Select or Unlimited Subscription

You may cancel your ESPN Select or Unlimited subscription at any time. You’ll continue to have access to it until the end of your current billing cycle, but you will not be charged moving forward. We do not offer refunds or credits for partially used billing periods. Please keep in mind that canceling your subscription will not delete your ESPN account — you can still log in using your ESPN credentials to experience the ESPN app without an ESPN subscription. #### To Cancel your ESPN Subscription 1. Log in to your ESPN account through a computer or mobile browser 2. Hover over (web) or select (mobile browser) your Profile picture in the upper right corner of the page 3. Select Account under the Manage My Account section 4. Select Manage Subscription 5. Click on the Subscription under Plans & Billing 6. Select the plan you wish to cancel 7. Select “Cancel” and confirm your cancellation (effective the end of your billing cycle)

IMPORTANT NOTE: If your ESPN subscription is billed through a third party, such as Apple, Google, Roku, etc., you must visit the third-party partner’s website to manage or review your subscription options.

ESPN Insider Legacy Subscription Management

To update or cancel an active legacy ESPN Insider subscription, click here and select Subscriptions.

How to Upgrade your ESPN Subscription from Select to Unlimited or from Monthly to Annual

Upgrading your ESPN subscription follows the same steps whether you are looking to switch from Select to Unlimited or taking advantage of the savings by switching from month to month to an annual version of your plan.  In this example, we are upgrading from Select monthly to an Unlimited annual. 1. Log in to your account, then access your profile (top right corner of the screen on ESPN.com. Then select Account under the Manage my: column on the left of the pop-up. 2. Click on your current subscription under Your Plan. 3. You will now have the ability to change your plan, payment method, or cancel.  We will be changing the plan from ESPN Select (Monthly) to ESPN Unlimited (Annual). 4. Click the Change link. 5. You will be presented with all current plans from which to choose.  We are going with ESPN Unlimited (Annual).  Click on the desired plan, then click on Review Changes. 6. You will now be able to review and confirm your changes.  When you are satisfied, click on Agree & Subscribe. 7. You are all set!

Managing An ESPN Subscription

ESPN subscribers can manage their subscriptions at any time. Please note that if your prior ESPN subscription was billed through a third party, such as Apple or Google, etc., you must visit the third-party partner’s website to manage or review your subscription options. ESPN select and unlimited subscriptions are direct purchases on ESPN.com #### Switch between an ESPN Monthly and an Annual Subscription* To switch your subscription: 1. Log in to your ESPN account through a computer or mobile browser. 2. Hover over (web) or select (mobile browser) your Profile picture in the upper right corner of the page. 3. Select Subscriptions under the Manage my section 4. Select Manage Subscription 5. Under the Subscription section, select Annual 6. Review your billing details, then select Agree & Subscribe.

NOTE: Changing from an Annual plan to a Monthly plan will take effect on your next billing date. You will receive a prorated billing credit for your monthly plan, which takes effect on your next billing date. #### Manage a Disney+ bundled subscription. The steps for managing a Disney+ bundled subscription can be found on the Disney+ Help Center. Please note that the email address and password you used when signing up for Disney+ will be your MyDisney login. With MyDisney, you can use one email address and password to log in to services and experiences across The Walt Disney Family of Companies. Access to certain features will vary depending on your plan — learn more about the different subscription offerings. Please note that the plans available to you may vary if you’re billed by Hulu or a third party. Additionally, some billing partners may determine which Disney+ subscription is included in the packages they offer. If you would like to change your plan, you will need to contact your billing partner directly. IMPORTANT: By changing your plan, you will lose the benefit of any current promotion or price hold. Subject to regional availability. Ads will be served in select live and linear programming. Your experience may also include certain promotional or sponsored content; for more information, read about ads on Disney+.* Click here to learn more about changing your Disney+ subscription and billing details.

MyDisney Wallet

MyDisney Wallet enables you to use your saved cards to easily pay for select services and experiences across The Walt Disney Family of Companies, including Disney+, ESPN, Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort, and Disney Store. Get started by searching for payment cards you may have previously saved within The Walt Disney Family of Companies to add them to your Wallet. When you clear your card history, the previously used payment cards will no longer be available for purchases across The Walt Disney Family of Companies unless manually added when purchasing. No changes will be made to your payment details for any active streaming subscriptions. NOTE: Participation in MyDisney Wallet is optional. - How to Set up MyDisney Wallet

New Accounts - Existing Accounts - Deferred MyDisney Wallet Enrollment

  • Add or Edit a Card
  • Remove a Card

How to Set Up MyDisney Wallet

New Accounts

When you create a new account during subscribing on ESPN you will have the option to participate in MyDisney Wallet during the payment phase. After entering your credit card or payment instrument, you will see the option to use MyDisney Wallet.  Just check the box and it will be activated once you complete the sign up process. (image: My Disney Wallet set up new.png) ##### Existing Accounts If you already have an ESPN or Disney account and are subscribing for the first time, you will see the option to use MyDisney Wallet during the Payment phase of the subscription process.  When you select this option, you will be prompted to search for existing cards. For example, you have a Disney account and have used your credit card elsewhere in The Walt Disney Family of Companies.  Searching enables MyDisney Wallet to register that card for future use. Click on the MyDisney Wallet option to begin. (image: My Disney Wallet set up existing new sub.png) Select Search for Cards. (image: My Disney Wallet set up search.png) Any credit card(s) attached to your account in our system will be displayed.  You will be able to select which cards you wish to use in MyDisney Wallet.  Simply check the box for each desired card. Once you have checked your selections, click on ADD SELECTED CARDS. NOTE: You may reject all cards by clicking on REJECT ALL CARDS.  If you do this, you will need to enter a new credit card or payment method. (image: My Disney Wallet select and add.png) Once selected, you will see your MyDisney Wallet listed.  The credit card with the checkmark is the credit card that will be used for making payments. The pencil icon allows you to edit the credit card. Add New Card enables you to add a new credit card to MyDisney Wallet. (image: My Disney Wallet card view.png) ##### Deferred MyDisney Wallet Enrollment You may decide skip setting up MyDisney Wallet and enroll at a later time.  If you do this, enrolling in MyDisney Wallet is simple.  Go into your Account the select Subscription Details.  Locate Payment Method and click on Change.  This initiates the option to set up MyDisney Wallet. (image: My Disney Wallet deferred.png) #### How to Manage MyDisney Wallet ##### ADD OR EDIT A CREDIT CARD Go into your Account then select Subscription Details.  Locate Payment Method and click on Change. (image: My Disney Wallet change.png) You will now see your current MyDisney Wallet credit cards and the option to Add Card. Selecting Add Card opens up the entry field for your credit card details. Clicking on the Add Card button once finished, uploads the card and selects that as the current payment method. NOTE: To edit an existing credit card, select the pencil icon next to the listed credit card. You can use this option when updating an expiration date on the current credit card. (image: My Disney Wallet add new card.png) ##### TO REMOVE A CREDIT CARD To remove a credit card, such as when it expires, go into your Account the select Subscription Details.  Locate Payment Method and click on Change. (image: My Disney Wallet change.png) Your MyDisney Wallet will display. Expired cards will be flagged for your reference. Select the pencil icon next to the card you wish to remove. Then click on Remove Card. NOTE: You can also edit the expiration date and click on Save Card to update the information. Payment Methods for ESPN Select or Unlimited

You can purchase an ESPN subscription through any of the following payment methods: - Disney Visa - Visa - Mastercard - Amex - Discover - PayPal (as a form of digital payment)

Payment Not Accepted or Processed

If your payment method is not being accepted or processed, the following are possible causes: •    Debit or credit card is expired •    Billing information does not match (Check that the card number, CVV, and expiration date were entered correctly) •    Debit or credit card has insufficient funds •    Debit or credit card issuer is not supported  •    Billing address is in a different country/region from where you are subscribing

If you have a billing issue, we will attempt to charge your payment method multiple times. If the billing issue persists, your account may go into a billing hold. Please note if your subscription is on a billing hold, it will remain active, but you will not be able to stream ESPN content until you update your payment information. If you’re billed by a third party, you will be directed to their website to manage your payment method. If you’re still having trouble, please contact us for assistance.

Switching from ESPN Select to Unlimited (or vice versa)

If you are changing from the Select plan to the Unlimited plan, the change takes effect immediately. You will be charged a prorated amount for the first month or year of your new plan. Moving forward, you will remain on your new plan for the life of your subscription and will be charged at the then-applicable price for this plan. If you’re changing to the Select plan, the change takes effect on your next billing date. NOTE: Once you’ve been charged for an annual plan, you will not be able to switch to monthly billing for the same plan immediately. If you are having issues changing your plan, please start a live chat with us for additional support by clicking on the Fanbot icon at the bottom right of this page.

Updating ESPN Account Email Address & Password

CHANGE EMAIL ADDRESS

IMPORTANT: ESPN Fan Support CANNOT change/edit Account Email Addresses.
  1. Hover over the Account icon on the top right of your screen.
  2. Click ESPN Profile. Under Email, select Edit.
  3. Check your inbox for an email from ESPN with the subject: Your ESPN Account Passcode.
  4. Enter your verification code to verify your email address.
  5. Now enter your new email address and select “Save”.

CHANGE PASSWORD IN PROFILE

  1. To change your password, within the Account Icon, under Change Password, type in your current password and your new password.
  2. Scroll down and select the blue Done button.

FORGOTTEN PASSWORD RESET

  1. Click on the Profile button (far right top corner on ESPN.com home page).
  2. Click on “Log In” (left side menu)
  3. Click on “Need help signing in?”
  4. Enter the email address associated with your account.
  5. A temporary passcode will be emailed to the address you entered.
  6. This is what the email looks like.
  7. Enter the passcode, then tap “Continue.”
  8. You may now proceed to access your account by tapping “Finish Sign-in”. However, it is advisable to take the opportunity to set a new password by tapping “Reset Password”.
  9. Enter your new password.  NOTE: This field is case-sensitive. Tap the box next to “Show password” to see what you are entering.
  10. Tap “Done” when ready.
  11. Now tap “Save” to update your password.  You will now be logged into the ESPN Fantasy App.

Updating Payment Info

To update your payment information on ESPN, log in to your account on the ESPN website or app, navigate to your ESPN subscriptions, and then select Manage Subscription and Update Payment. Follow the on-screen instructions to enter your new payment details.

Who Can I Share My ESPN Select or Unlimited Subscription With?

You may not share your subscription outside of your household. “Household” means the collection of devices associated with your primary personal residence that are used by the individuals who reside therein.

Why did I receive an email about my ESPN+ account becoming ESPN Unlimited?

As part of preparations for the upcoming launch of the new ESPN Unlimited plan offering, ESPN content is now available for all our existing ESPN+ and Disney+ bundle plan subscribers who are billed through TV Providers (E.g., Spectrum, Fubo TV,  DIRECTV, Verizon FiOS).

Select Watch Now next to Hulu 3. Create your new Hulu account and start streaming

Can a Disney+ Extra Member purchase and/or view an ESPN Pay Per View event?

No. A Disney+ or Disney bundle “Extra Member” will not have a payment method associated with their account to buy a PPV.  If an Extra Member wishes to purchase an ESPN Pay Per View event (such as a Top Rank Boxing Pay Per View streaming event), they must give up their Extra Member benefit and create their own ESPN or Disney Bundle subscription, after which they can immediately purchase the PPV on their own account. Current Extra Members can check with Disney+ to learn how to remove their account from the Extra Member seat. Note: PPVs purchased by a Disney bundle Account Owner are viewable/accessible only on that account, not by Extra Members. Click here for more information about Disney+ Extra Member.

ESPN Select & Unlimited in bundled subscriptions with Disney+ and Hulu

Interested in getting ESPN Select or Unlimited as part of a bundled subscription with Disney+ and Hulu? You’re in the right place — find all the details you need to get started. NOTE: ESPN+ is now a network with content that is exclusive to ESPN Select and Unlimited subscribers. You can choose to bundle all three streaming services, or just Disney+ and Hulu, depending on the plan you sign up for. Already have Disney+?

ESPN Unlimited & Select: ESPN App Features

How can I view my fantasy sports matchup or pick’ em games in real time, on my smart TV or living room device?

Fantasy team owners and pick ’em game players can sign into their ESPN account, on any Smart TV or supported device, and follow all their league manager and pick ’em games in real time, no matter what ESPN content they may be watching  (XBOX and PlayStation not included). All scoring type and league manager games are included. If users do not have a fantasy team, there is a QR code displayed on the screen to get started.  The experience is strictly for viewing matchup scores. There is no adding of players or making lineup changes.  Simply login to your ESPN account, link the viewing experience and watch your scores in real-time!  Here’s how:                                                                                                                                     Step 1: Open the ESPN app on your appropriate device Step 2 : Navigate to the fantasy tab Step 3: Scan the QR code to log in or download the fantasy app Step 4: If you do not have any teams, get drafting! If you have teams, they will now appear on your living room device!

How do I get access to SportsCenter For You?

Users will need to be authenticated via their TV Provider (and have ESPN as part of their channel package) and logged into their ESPN Unlimited subscription in order to view SportsCenter for You. Users can also access SportsCenter for You by activating ESPN Unlimited, if they do not have a TV package service.  Note, the feature is available on the US-English Edition only and also appears as “SC For You” on the Watch section of ESPN.com or the authentication flow on the mobile device or living room device, where users can login to view this personalized experience. SportsCenter for You is not available for ESPN Select standalone subscribers.

How do I use StreamCenter?

  1. To use StreamCenter, you must log in to the ESPN app on both your mobile and connected device, with the same account.
  2. A free ESPN account is the only requirement to use StreamCenter! Premium subscriptions are not required.
  3. Once logged in, you should receive a notification and an in-app prompt to connect your mobile device to your connected device.
  4. After connecting, StreamCenter will appear as a docked player in the ESPN app.
  5. Clicking on the docked player opens the full-screen experience.

How often is a new SportsCenter For You Episode Available?

Fans will receive a new episode every day, with fresh content that provides updates of your favorite teams (highlights), favorite sports and leagues, as well as top plays from the previous day.

What are “Verts”?

Verts are ESPN’s modern video experience that reimagines how fans can watch video clips in the ESPN App.  Verts are easy to access via the Verts tab in the ESPN App, in the bottom navigation panel. Fans will also have a Verts carousel in their ESPN App Home Feed, where they can tap on the videos in this collection to navigate the tab.

What devices support Multiview?

ESPN Multiview will work on the following devices: - Android TV (ESPN App Version 6.0.2 and above) - Fire TV (ESPN App Version 6.0.2 and above) - Roku (ESPN App Version 6.0 and above) - Samsung (ESPN App Version 3.16 and above) - LG (ESPN App Version 3.16 and above) - Comcast (ESPN App Version 3.16 and above) - Cox (ESPN App Version 3.16 and above) - Charter (ESPN App Version 3.16 and above)

What is Multiview?

Watch up to four games at once on your big screen. Note: Multiview is pre-curated. ESPN selects the combinations. Users cannot customize the Multiview.  Multiview is available to ESPN Select and Unlimited subscribers.

What is SportsCenter for You? (SC For You)

SportsCenter for You (SC For You) is a daily, personalized, premium video package of highlights and must-see news available in the ESPN Mobile App, ESPN.com, and the ESPN App on supported living room devices. SportsCenter For You will be AI-generated and tailored to each individual fan—everything you want, just for you!

What is the available content on ESPN Select?

ESPN Select includes the full ESPN+ library. ESPN Select plan subscribers have access to ESPN+, with 30,000+ events, including every match from LALIGA and FA Cup, as well as season-long PGA TOUR coverage, NHL games, and a selection of events from a wide variety of sports, including college football, men’s and women’s college basketball, and other college sports, PLL, and more.

How do I cancel the ESPN, FOX One bundle?

How to opt out of data sharing for the ESPN, FOX One Bundle

You can opt out of ESPN’s ongoing sharing of this data with FOX (other than for ESPN, FOX One Bundle support) by filling out this opt-out form. The opt-out form is also available through the “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” link in our ESPN website footers.

How will billing appear for the ESPN, FOX One bundle subscription?

The ESPN, FOX One Bundle costs $39.99/month.  You will see one monthly charge from the platform where you purchased the bundle.  To manage or cancel, go back to that same platform. If you purchased through ESPN, you will manage your subscription on ESPN.com directly in your account.

I already have a Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Bundle. Can I add/sign up for the ESPN, FOX One Bundle?

The ESPN, FOX One Bundle is not available for subscribers of a bundle that already includes an ESPN plan. If you wish to change your current plan to subscribe to the ESPN, FOX One Bundle, you can go to your account on ESPN.com, select “Manage My Account”, select “Manage with MyDisney”, select the plan you wish to cancel, and then select Cancel, so that you can then subscribe to the ESPN, FOX One Bundle.

I have the ESPN Unlimited with NFL+ Premium service. Can I add/sign up for the ESPN, FOX One Bundle?

The ESPN, FOX One bundle is not available to ESPN Unlimited subscribers with NFL+ Premium.

I signed up but can’t watch, what should I do?

You may still need to complete activation on the FOX One service.  Look for an email reminder or restart activation on ESPN.com.

What is the ESPN Unlimited, FOX One bundle?

The ESPN, FOX One Bundle is a streaming package that offers both ESPN Unlimited and FOX’s direct-to-consumer streaming service for $39.99/month. In addition to all ESPN Unlimited offers, FOX One is a new streaming service from FOX. It’s designed for anyone without cable or those who’ve cut the cord, bringing together all your favorite FOX channels in one place, including: FOX News, FOX Business, FOX Weather, FOX Sports, FS1, FS2, Big Ten Network (B1G), FOX Deportes, the FOX Network, and local FOX stations. You can now purchase the ESPN, FOX One Bundle directly through ESPN. For more information on FOX One, visitthe FOX website here. This bundle is currently only available from the ESPN and FOX websites. NOTE: This bundle is not offered through Disney+ or Hulu, and each subscription may only be accessed in its respective app.

What is the price of the ESPN Unlimited, FOX One bundle?

ESPN Unlimited & Select: Fix A Problem

Do I need to be near my connected device to connect to StreamCenter?

StreamCenter is account based, so you don’t need to be near your connected device to connect. If you are signed into multiple connected devices that may be streaming content, you have the ability to switch devices you are connected to or completely disconnect from StreamCenter. If you are away from your connected device and someone else begins streaming, you can disable StreamCenter on your mobile device.

ESPN Select or Unlimited Internal Connection Speed Recommendations

For a good streaming experience, ESPN recommends at least 5.0 Mbps for HD content and 25.0 Mbps for 4K UHD content. A stable internet connection with these speeds or better is crucial for smooth playback. If you encounter buffering or playback issues, testing your internet speed and ensuring you’re using a supported device can help.

Fixing a Blank Screen or Spinning Wheel Issue

Playback issues include buffering, freezing, or other related errors, but you may also run into connection issues like a blank screen or spinning wheel. If you experience one of these problems while watching a live event or original content on ESPN+, we recommend trying the respective troubleshooting steps below. #### Blank screen Ensure that you do not have a content filter, antivirus application, proxy accelerator or pop-up blocker enabled. If you do, disable these services and try again. #### Spinning wheel If you’re seeing a spinning wheel when using the ESPN app, please follow these steps: 1. Refresh, close, or restart your web browser or app and open it again 2. Close other applications on your device that may be running at the same time 3. If your device is on a mobile 3G, 4G or 5G network, try using a Wi-Fi network for more reliable video streaming

If those steps don’t resolve the trouble, check out our video playback troubleshooting steps next. For even further assistance, please contact ESPN+ Support.

How can I manually connect, switch devices, or turn StreamCenter off?

StreamCenter can be accessed through the device management button in the ESPN mobile app header or in the video player. Selecting this button gives you access to StreamCenter, Casting, and Airplay.

How can I stop my mobile device from autoconnecting?

To prevent your mobile device from automatically connecting to StreamCenter, you can either disable auto-connect for specific devices or turn off Bluetooth entirely. You can also unpair devices to prevent future automatic connections.

How do I disable StreamCenter auto-reconnect?

In Settings > StreamCenter Settings, disable the Auto-Reconnect toggle.

How do I enable or disable notification quiet hours?

In Settings > StreamCenter Settings, disable the Snooze Game Alerts toggle.

How do I enable or disable the device detected notification?

In Settings > StreamCenter Settings, disable the Device Detected Messaging toggle.

How do I find a Multiview screen experience?

Browse the mobile app or ESPN.com Top Live (Featured or Live) breakout rows on the “Watch” section.  Once there, you will see a quad-screen/multiview tile with curated event content to choose from.  Simply tap or click on the content of your choosing.

Performing a Power Cycle

Completely powering off your streaming device and restarting it can help to refresh your connection, especially if you’re not meeting our internet speed recommendations. To perform a power cycle, follow these steps: 1. Turn off the device you’re using to watch ESPN 2. Turn your modem and router off and disconnect them from the power source

This step isn’t relevant if you are using cellular data via your mobile carrier

Additional troubleshooting can also help improve your internet connection and resolve common playback issues. Please contact ESPN Fan Support for further assistance.

Troubleshooting Playback and Streaming Issues

Several issues can be a factor in video playback errors and stream quality. If you’re having problems, we recommend first reviewing and verifying the following: - Streaming device is supported: Verify the device is supportedand updated to the latest supported version of its OS or platform. - Internet connection is stable: If your connection is slow or unstable, try turning your modem and router off and on again. Also, please note that the following conditions can affect streaming quality, even if you have a strong connection:

The distance between a streaming device and a Wi-Fi router - The number of devices connected to your network - Outage or network issue with your internet provider

If your device is supported and your connection meets our internet speed recommendations, try running through the following troubleshooting steps to resolve the problem (try playing the video again after each step): - Force close and relaunch the ESPN app - Power down and restart your streaming device - Check your internet connection - Check the HDMI connections on your streaming device - Test streaming content on another app - Uninstall and reinstall the ESPN app - Test streaming from the ESPN app on another device

If you attempted each of these steps and are still having trouble, please contact ESPN Support for assistance.

Uninstalling/Reinstalling the ESPN App

To uninstall and reinstall the ESPN app, you’ll first need to uninstall it from your device. Please review the app uninstall/reinstall directions for your specific device. After uninstalling, fully power off and on your device. Then, navigate to the  device’s App or Play Store, search for ESPN, and reinstall the app. Log back in with your existing username and password.

Fixing Login Issues — Clearing Your Cache & Cookies (Chrome, Safari & Firefox)

Fixing Login Issues — Clearing Your Cache & Cookies

Your browser stores bits of website data to help pages load faster—but sometimes that stored data becomes outdated, causing problems like login issues or pages not displaying correctly. Clearing it out is quick and easy! Just find your browser below and follow the steps. Heads up: After clearing your cache and cookies, you’ll likely be logged out of websites you normally stay signed into—including ESPN. Just log back in as usual, and you should be good to go! ##### Google Chrome (Desktop) 1. Click the three vertical dots (⋮) in the top-right corner of Chrome 2. Hover over History, then click History again in the menu that appears 3. On the left side, click Clear browsing data 4. Set the Time Range to All time 5. Make sure both Cookies and other site data, and Cached images and files are checked 6. Click Clear data 7. Close Chrome completely and reopen it, then head back to ESPN and try logging in again

Google Chrome (Mobile — iPhone or Android)
  1. Tap the three dots in the top-right corner (Android) or bottom-right corner (iPhone)
  2. Tap History, then Clear browsing data
  3. Set the Time Range to All time
  4. Make sure Cookies, site data, and Cached images and files are both selected
  5. Tap Clear data and confirm
  6. Head back to ESPN and try logging in again
Apple Safari (Desktop — Mac)
  1. Click Safari in the top menu bar and select Settings (or Preferences on older Macs)
  2. Click the Privacy tab
  3. Click Manage Website Data, then Remove All
  4. Confirm by clicking Remove Now
  5. Close and reopen Safari, then head back to ESPN and try logging in again

Shortcut option: You can also click History in the top menu bar, select Clear History, set it to All History, and click Clear History to confirm. ##### Apple Safari (Mobile — iPhone or iPad) 1. Open the Settings app on your device (not Safari itself) 2. Scroll down and tap Apps, then tap Safari 3. Tap Clear History and Website Data 4. Select your preferred timeframe and tap Clear History and Data to confirm 5. Head back to ESPN and try logging in again

Mozilla Firefox (Desktop)
  1. Click the three horizontal lines (☰) in the top-right corner of Firefox
  2. Click Settings
  3. On the left, click Privacy & Security
  4. Scroll down to the Cookies and Site Data section and click Clear Data
  5. Make sure both Cookies, Site Data, and Cached Web Content are checked
  6. Click Clear, then confirm by clicking Clear Now
  7. Close Firefox completely and reopen it, then head back to ESPN and try logging in again
Pro Tip

On Windows or Mac, you can also use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Shift + Delete (Windows) or ⌘ + Shift + Delete (Mac) while in any of these browsers to jump straight to the clear data screen! If you’ve cleared your cache and cookies and are still having trouble, don’t hesitate to reach out to ESPN Fan Support by clicking on the chat icon at the lower right of this screen— we’re happy to help!

How many devices can stream ESPN subscriptions simultaneously?

ESPN subscriptions allow simultaneous streaming on up to three (3) devices for most content, including on-demand shows and live events.

Is ESPN+ for Business changing?

There is no change to the “ESPN+ for Business” product. Click here to learn more.

Is ESPN+ going away?

No. Existing ESPN+ subscribers will remain subscribers of the ESPN Select plan and continue to enjoy access to all ESPN+ content. New subscribers can still access ESPN+ via the ESPN Select and Unlimited plans, including as part of the Disney+, Hulu, ESPN bundles, which you can purchase through ESPN, Disney+ or Hulu. Certain TV Packages will also continue to provide ESPN+ content in these new plans.

Is There a Disney Bundle that Includes ESPN Unlimited?

Yes! You can now stream even more of your favorite sports, live events, movies, and TV shows with one bundle plan. Starting August 21, 2025, and ending on January 5th, 2026, you can sign up for a monthly subscription of a Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle plan at a discounted price for 12 months. What devices support ESPN Select and Unlimited?

ESPN Select and Unlimited subscriptions are supported on tVOS, FireTV, AndroidTV, Android and iOS mobile devices, Kindle Fire tablet, XBox, One, Roku, PS4 and PS5

What do I get with ESPN Unlimited that I don’t already get with ESPN+ or won’t get with ESPN Select?

ESPN’s Unlimited plan subscribers have access to all ESPN networks and services, including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SECN, ACCN, ESPN+, ESPN on ABC, SECN+, ACCNX, and ESPN3.

What ESPN content is available on Disney+?

Subscribers with a linked ESPN Select or Unlimited subscription, or a Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Bundle subscription will receive access to ESPN content in the Disney+ app. With an ESPN Select subscription, you can expect to see all ESPN+ content, including college football, NHL, tennis, soccer, mixed martial arts, college sports, and additional ESPN Films and Originals. Subscribers with access to ESPN Unlimited receive access to all ESPN Select content, plus access to all of ESPN’s networks and services - including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, SECN, ACCN, ESPN Deportes, as well as ESPN+, ESPN on ABC, ESPN3, SECN+, and ACCNX.

What is ESPN Select?

ESPN Select is the subscription plan that will consist entirely of ESPN+ content.  Existing ESPN+ subscribers have been converted into ESPN Select subscribers, but they will continue to have access to the same ESPN+ service. ESPN Select plan subscribers have access to ESPN+, with top-tier soccer, PGA TOUR, NHL, college sports, and a selection of other ESPN programming.

What is ESPN Unlimited?

ESPN Unlimited plan subscribers have access to all ESPN networks and ESPN+, with sports like NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, tennis and golf majors, WWE, SEC, ACC, and Big 12 football and basketball, postseason coverage from the NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL, MLB, College Football Playoff, and more, as well as studio shows like SportsCenter, First Take, and College GameDay. This plan includes ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SECN, ACCN, ESPN+, ESPN on ABC, SECN+, ACCNX, and the NFL Network. NOTE: When activating an ESPN Unlimited subscription through a TV Provider, you may not receive certain ESPN Unlimited content if your TV provider does not carry such content.

What is StreamCenter?

How do you manage multiple live events across multiple devices or screens without getting lost? That’s what StreamCenter is built for. It’s a smart, centralized hub in the ESPN app where you can manage all things live streaming. StreamCenter is a behind-the-scenes framework inside the ESPN app. It detects when you are watching live content and creates a control layer for returning, resuming, or navigating streams across your devices. With StreamCenter, you can sync stats and alerts while watching live games on the big screen, controlling the “on TV” experience with a mobile device. (Click here to learn how to activate and use StreamCenter.) #### StreamCenter Benefits: - Easily resume a stream on another device - Manage which device is currently in control - Save your spot if you switch away mid-event - No need to search again for what you were watching

What is the available content on ESPN Unlimited?

ESPN Unlimited offers all ESPN content available to viewers today. ESPN Unlimited plan subscribers have access to all ESPN networks and ESPN+, with sports like NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, tennis and golf majors, SEC, ACC, and Big 12 football and basketball, postseason coverage from the NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL, MLB, College Football Playoff, and more, as well as studio shows like SportsCenter, First Take and College GameDay. This plan includes ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SECN, ACCN, ESPN+, ESPN on ABC, SECN+, ACCNX, and the NFL Network. NOTE: When activating an ESPN Unlimited subscription through a TV Provider, you may not receive certain ESPN Unlimited content if your TV provider does not carry such content.

What is the difference between ESPN+ and ESPN Select?

ESPN+ is available to fans in both our ESPN Select and Unlimited Plans.  ESPN Select includes ESPN+ content only. Fans who want ESPN+ exclusively may subscribe to the ESPN Select plan.  ESPN Unlimited includes all of the ESPN networks and services, including ESPN+.  Certain TV packages continue to provide ESPN+ content in these plans.

ESPN Unlimited & Select: MLB.TV

After purchase, how do I link my MLB.TV plan and ESPN Unlimited plan subscriptions/accounts?

Once you purchase MLB.TV, you can watch out-of-market MLB broadcasts directly on ESPN using your ESPN account, on ESPN.com, or on the ESPN App. For the additional MLB.TV content available only on the MLB app, you can link your ESPN Account to your MLB Account to log into the MLB App. You can link your ESPN and MLB Accounts no matter where you purchased MLB.TV For users who purchased MLB.TV from ESPN who need to activate to watch on MLB: 1. Go to ESPN Account Management  2. You will see an option under “Your Other Services” to activate your MLBTV subscription 3. From there, follow the steps to link your MLB account with your MyDisney Account 4. Once linked, you can now access content across both the ESPN and MLB apps For users who already have MLB.TV from MLB who need to activate to watch on ESPN: 1. Go to MLB Account Management (Click on the profile icon located at the top right of MLB.com pages)  2. You will see an option to activate your MLB.TV subscription on ESPN 3. From there, follow the steps to link your MLB account with your MyDisney Account 4. Once linked, you can now access content across both the ESPN and MLB apps

Can I access my subscription from any computer, anywhere, at any time?

Yes, however, MLB.TV on ESPN is only available in the US market; you will also be subject to MLB blackout restrictions. For more information about blackouts and to search for blackout areas, click here. If the computer meets the system requirements, then you can log in with your ESPN account to access your subscription from anywhere at any time.

Can I cancel ESPN Unlimited and keep MLB.TV?

Yes, you can remove ESPN Unlimited from your subscription and retain MLB.TV by itself.

Can I pause the ESPN Unlimited plan or MLB.TV plan during or after the MLB Season?

There is no option to pause ESPN Unlimited or MLB.TV during or after the MLB season; however, you can cancel auto-renewal to stop future charges, giving you access until the current paid period ends. Also note that MLB.TV Monthly subscribers will not be charged after October of each season, with those monthly charges resuming on or about March 1st each season.

Can I purchase MLB.TV with an ESPN Unlimited Monthly or Annual subscription?

Yes. MLB.TV Monthly and Seasonal plans are both available with ESPN Unlimited monthly and annual plans. New subscribers interested in the one-month free trial of ESPN Unlimited must sign up for the monthly ESPN Unlimited plan.

Can I Share My Account with Others?

No. Sharing of your credentials (username and password) is strictly prohibited.

How am I billed upon MLB season end?

MLB.TV Monthly subscriptions will renew monthly through October, then automatically restart on or around March 1, unless canceled. Deleting your ESPN Account

Deleting my ESPN Account

Deleting your ESPN account is very different from canceling your ESPN subscription. Deleting your ESPN account deletes your email address, first and last name, and profile name and attributes. It also anonymizes all other ESPN account information so that it is no longer associated with your email address, and you are unsubscribed from all marketing emails from ESPN. You can delete your ESPN account at any time after first canceling your ESPN subscription; however, deleting your ESPN account will remove account access to other experiences across the Walt Disney Family of companies, with the exception of Disney+, Hulu, and your MyDisney Identity.  IMPORTANT: Deleting your ESPN account does not cancel any ESPN subscription. If you delete your ESPN account without canceling your ESPN subscription, you may continue to be charged for your ESPN subscription without being able to access it. Please ensure you have canceled your ESPN subscription before deleting your ESPN account. #### Canceling my ESPN Subscription Canceling your ESPN subscription and deleting your ESPN account are not the same. Before you delete your ESPN account, you must first cancel your subscription. This ensures that you are no longer paying for your monthly or annual ESPN subscription after deleting your account. If you are billed through a third party, you will need to cancel your ESPN subscription through them. For more information on how to cancel your ESPN subscription, click here. #### Delete my ESPN Account Once you have canceled your ESPN subscription and/or no longer want to access ESPN, you can take the following steps to delete your ESPN account. 1. Log in to your ESPN account through a computer or mobile browser 2. Select your Profile 3. Select Account 4. Under Settings, select Delete Account

For more information about other rights you have regarding your personal information, please review our Privacy Policy.

Fixing Login Issues — Clearing Your Cache & Cookies (Chrome, Safari & Firefox)

Fixing Login Issues — Clearing Your Cache & Cookies

Your browser stores bits of website data to help pages load faster—but sometimes that stored data becomes outdated, causing problems like login issues or pages not displaying correctly. Clearing it out is quick and easy! Just find your browser below and follow the steps. Heads up: After clearing your cache and cookies, you’ll likely be logged out of websites you normally stay signed into—including ESPN. Just log back in as usual, and you should be good to go! ##### Google Chrome (Desktop) 1. Click the three vertical dots (⋮) in the top-right corner of Chrome 2. Hover over History, then click History again in the menu that appears 3. On the left side, click Clear browsing data 4. Set the Time Range to All time 5. Make sure both Cookies and other site data, and Cached images and files are checked 6. Click Clear data 7. Close Chrome completely and reopen it, then head back to ESPN and try logging in again

Google Chrome (Mobile — iPhone or Android)
  1. Tap the three dots in the top-right corner (Android) or bottom-right corner (iPhone)
  2. Tap History, then Clear browsing data
  3. Set the Time Range to All time
  4. Make sure Cookies, site data, and Cached images and files are both selected
  5. Tap Clear data and confirm
  6. Head back to ESPN and try logging in again
Apple Safari (Desktop — Mac)
  1. Click Safari in the top menu bar and select Settings (or Preferences on older Macs)
  2. Click the Privacy tab
  3. Click Manage Website Data, then Remove All
  4. Confirm by clicking Remove Now
  5. Close and reopen Safari, then head back to ESPN and try logging in again

Shortcut option: You can also click History in the top menu bar, select Clear History, set it to All History, and click Clear History to confirm. ##### Apple Safari (Mobile — iPhone or iPad) 1. Open the Settings app on your device (not Safari itself) 2. Scroll down and tap Apps, then tap Safari 3. Tap Clear History and Website Data 4. Select your preferred timeframe and tap Clear History and Data to confirm 5. Head back to ESPN and try logging in again

Mozilla Firefox (Desktop)
  1. Click the three horizontal lines (☰) in the top-right corner of Firefox
  2. Click Settings
  3. On the left, click Privacy & Security
  4. Scroll down to the Cookies and Site Data section and click Clear Data
  5. Make sure both Cookies, Site Data, and Cached Web Content are checked
  6. Click Clear, then confirm by clicking Clear Now
  7. Close Firefox completely and reopen it, then head back to ESPN and try logging in again
Pro Tip

On Windows or Mac, you can also use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl + Shift + Delete (Windows) or ⌘ + Shift + Delete (Mac) while in any of these browsers to jump straight to the clear data screen! If you’ve cleared your cache and cookies and are still having trouble, don’t hesitate to reach out to ESPN Fan Support by clicking on the chat icon at the lower right of this screen— we’re happy to help!

How do I authenticate or log in to the ESPN app if I subscribe with a participating provider?

As long as you subscribe to a TV package that includes ESPN and your account is in good standing, you will be able to view all streaming content that mirrors what you see on your TV service. Before you begin, make sure you have the credentials (user name/password) you use with your TV Provider. 1. Download the ESPN app on your mobile or tablet device. 2. Launch the ESPN app. 3. Log in using your ESPN.com credentials. If you do not have an ESPN.com account, you will be prompted to create one. 4. The first time you try to stream any content, you will be prompted to log in with the username and password your TV provider issued.

NOTE: If your TV provider’s credentials do not work, contact them for further troubleshooting.

How do I verify my account?

To play live ESPN programming, you will need to sign in with your TV provider account. Select an ESPN event or select ‘choose provider’ from ESPN.com or the ESPN application. Select your TV provider from the provider list when prompted. Once you have successfully signed in to your provider account, you will be able to access programming and networks included in your current subscription.

How many concurrent streams does ESPN allow?

The ESPN app and ESPN.com currently provide for up to three concurrent streams. Please note that if you subscribe through a TV provider and access ESPN through your provider’s app (for example, Sling on DirecTV), they may impose different streaming limits. Contact your provider for more details. Quick Tip: If you are unable to stream on a device due to streaming limits, you can force a log-out of all devices using the methods below. #### Log out of all devices via ESPN.com 1. Log in to your account on ESPN.com 2. Hover over your profile avatar in the top right 3. Select ESPN Profile (if on the Home page) or Account (if on another page, such as one of the league pages) 4. Click on “More Security Settings” 5. This will take you to https://my.disney.com/access-security 6. Click on Log Out of Everywhere NOTE: Doing this will also log out of all devices for services across The Walt Disney Family of Companies — including Disney+, ESPN, Walt Disney World, and more.

Log out of all devices via the ESPN App

  1. Log in to the ESPN App
  2. Tap on the Gear icon in the top right corner of the screen
  3. Swipe down and tap on About MyDisneyYou will be prompted to log in again (for your security)
  4. Tap on Access & Security
  5. Click on Log Out of Everywhere NOTE: Doing this will also log out of all devices for services across The Walt Disney Family of Companies — including Disney+, ESPN, Walt Disney World, and more.

Re-authenticate on iOS/iPad

If you see a ‘user must reauthenticate’ message when you try to stream on ESPN App, please attempt the following steps on your device. 1. Open the “Settings” on your Apple Device.  (image: mceclip0.png) 2. Scroll towards the bottom of the page until you are able to locate ’TV Providers” (image: mceclip1.png) 3. Select this feature and opt to sign out of the current provider. (image: mceclip2.png) 4. You can now visit ESPN App and log in to your TV provider. 

Will I be required to sign in every time I use the ESPN app?

In most cases, there is no need to re-enter your verification credentials. Some TV providers may require you to re-verify your account after a predetermined time period.

Will I have access to the same networks on the ESPN app or ESPN.com if I log in away from home?

Yes. Once you log in to the ESPN app or ESPN.com or any OTT device, click on any event and enter your credentials used for your TV service provider.  You will have access to the same channels you see on your TV.

ESPN Via Your TV Provider: Content

“Continue Watching” for Videos on Demand

“Continue Watching” is a new feature for select ESPN Video on Demand (VOD) content. The Continue Watching feature works similarly to other streaming services by allowing you to pause watching your desired content then resume where you left off at a later time. Beginning in January 2022, the Continue Watching feature will start appearing on some VOD content. Initially, the Continue Watching feature will be available for tvOS, FireTV, AndroidTV, and Xbox. However, additional platforms (Roku, PS, etc.) will gain the feature as it rolls out. KEY POINTS -  The Continue Watching feature is available on iOS, tvOS, Android, FireTV, Samsung (Tizen), Cox, X1/X1 Flex, and Xbox.

Apple SharePlay on ESPN

ESPN fans using iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV can create a shared streaming experience with SharePlay*. With SharePlay fans stream live sports and other content with friends and family on FaceTime when everyone logs into the ESPN app with their TV provider or ESPN subscription on their own iOS and iPad devices. Picture-in-picture mode allows viewers to easily jump from the FaceTime chat and video into the content being streamed with the ability to pass the content stream to their Apple TV. All participants in the SharePlay session will be synced so they can enjoy the experience at the same time. Please note that each participant in an ESPN SharePlay session must have an active TVE provider and/or ESPN subscription. If you have questions about SharePlay or run into trouble while using the feature, select an option from the list below to learn more: - What do I need to use SharePlay? - What content can I watch during a SharePlay session? - How do I start a SharePlay session? - How do I join a SharePlay session? - I’m having trouble and need help

****NOTE: This feature is only available on iPhone and iPad—tvOS, and Mac devices are not supported at this time.* #### What do I need to use SharePlay?** To initiate or join a SharePlay session, you will need the following: - An active ESPN account with an eligible TV Provider subscription OR ESPN subscription. Click here for more information about TV Providers. . - A supported iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV device running iOS or iPadOS 15.1 or later. For more information on the SharePlay feature in general, click here. - The latest version of the ESPN app installed and updated on your device.

Not an ESPN subscriber? Sign up for ESPN and start streaming today! #### What content can I watch during a SharePlay session? During a SharePlay session, users can stream live ESPN linear content*** made available through a participating TV provider. ESPN subscribers also gain access to ESPN live events** and the ESPN content library. ESPN pay-per-view events ​​— such as Top Rank PPV events — can be watched via a SharePlay session provided that each user has purchased the event. NOTE: Replays and short-form clips are not eligible for SharePlay. Requires a subscription to a participating TV provider. Subject to regional blackouts based on user location. * #### How do I start a SharePlay session? Starting a SharePlay session varies by device. Follow the steps below to learn how: iPhone and iPad 1. On your iPhone or iPad, start a FaceTime call 2. Swipe from the bottom edge of the FaceTime call > open the ESPN app 3. Choose the event (ex., a live event or an ESPN Original) and press Play 4. If prompted, tap SharePlay

A SharePlay session can include up to 32 people. However, if your SharePlay session includes participants using profiles from the same account, please note that ESPN and TVE accounts allow up to 3 concurrent streams at a time (2 for PPV events). Once SharePlay begins, all participants will be synced together and can control playback by pausing, skipping, or changing the content being streamed. #### How do I join a SharePlay session? Joining a SharePlay session can vary depending on the device in use. Follow the steps below to learn how: iPhone and iPad 1. In a FaceTime call, tap Open next to Join SharePlay 2. After the ESPN app is opened, select Join SharePlay 3. Once accepted, you will be automatically taken back to the selected content 4. To return to the FaceTime call, tap the picture-in-picture tile on top of the screen

I’m having trouble with SharePlay and need help

If you’re running into trouble using SharePlay, please make sure you’re using a supported iOS, iPadOS, or tvOS device running the most recent software version. If the information above doesn’t relate to or resolve your problem with SharePlay, please contact us by clicking the Chat icon below.

How can I hide live scores from being shown?

The “Hide Live Scores” feature is currently available on Roku, Xbox, Samsung TV, Comcast X1/X1 Flex, and iOS/Android. In the future, it will also be available on Android TV, Fire TV, and tvOS. You can access this feature by navigating to “Video Settings” within the Settings page. “Live Score Data” (on by default), will show live scores underneath Live video tiles. By turning off “Live Score Data”, scores will be hidden underneath Live video tiles. This setting is only stored locally; it does not affect any other devices you may be logged into. Please repeat this process for all devices on which you wish to hide live scores. (image: mceclip0.png)

The Start From The Beginning function for Live Events

Starting on August 30, 2022, ESPN introduced the “Start from the Beginning” functionality in the US only.  This feature allows you to start Live events from the beginning instead of having to commence playback where the live feed is at the viewing time.  This feature is exclusively for live content in the Featured and ESPN tabs. Supported Devices - Samsung - Xbox - Apple TV - Fire TV - Android TV

How to use Start from the Beginning

To start from the beginning of a live event, click the contextual menu. To do this: 1. Focus on the video tile 2. Click the corresponding button for that tile on your remote. 3. Once in the menu, click the “Start from Beginning” option.

You can also edit your video settings to disable autoplay.  This will allow you to choose the “Start from Beginning” option.

Watching SEC College Football on ESPN+ or SEC Network+

ESPN is pleased to provide college football fans with the hottest SEC games via ESPN+ and SEC Network+. Watching SEC games on SEC Network+ SEC Network+ is the home for all your SEC College Football action!  Click here to see the upcoming schedule. Watching SEC games on ESPN+ Select SEC non-conference matchups will also be available via ESPN+. Click here to see the upcoming schedule.   #### Additional FAQs How many SEC games will be on ESPN+? Starting in 2021-22, select non-conference football and basketball games will appear on ESPN+.  If a game is airing on both SEC Network+ and ESPN+ simultaneously, where do I watch? Both streams will be available in the ESPN App. SEC Network authenticated subscribers of AT&T TV, Cox, DIRECTV, DISH Network, fuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, Optimum, Sling TV, Spectrum TV, Suddenlink, Verizon Fios, Xfinity TV, YouTube TV, Vidgo, members of the NCTC, as well as those with access to SEC Network through TV-connected devices, can watch the game via SEC Network+. If you do not have access to SEC Network, you can access games via a subscription to ESPN. Do I have to pay separately to access SEC Network+? No. SEC Network+ is complementary to SEC Network and part of your subscription with your cable, satellite, or streaming provider. If a game is on ESPN+ or SEC Network+, can I watch it on TV? SEC Network+ and ESPN+ are not television channels, but they are available via the ESPN App on your TV through connected streaming services and devices. Will the games on SEC Network+ and ESPN+ look any different? These games will have the same production value as games across all ESPN networks. For games airing simultaneously on SEC Network+ and ESPN+, both feeds will have the same on-air commentators and game coverage. Am I able to watch the network on my mobile phone or a similar device? Yes, SEC Network is available on SECNetwork.com and on connected devices. It is accessible with your TV credentials and can be accessed through the ESPN App on smartphones, tablets, connected streaming devices, or espn.com/watch via participating providers. Can I pay to subscribe to SEC Network or SEC Network+ online, Pay-Per-View, or via ESPN3 if I can’t get it on TV? No. However, with a cable or satellite subscription, you can access the network using your TV credentials through the ESPN App on smartphones, tablets, connected streaming devices or via espn.com/watch. How can I get SEC Network? SEC Network is distributed nationally as well as in the SEC footprint with providers large and small. You should have multiple provider options in your area. A list of current providers can be viewed on the SEC Network Channel Finder.

What is the Blackout Policy?

Certain live sporting events and other content available through your ESPN subscription may be subject to blackouts. For example, if you are in the home television territory of a team participating in a game, then the game may be blacked-out for viewing or live viewing as part of your ESPN subscription.  Blackouts will be enforced according to the location from which you are accessing the ESPN service or the applicable third-party services, and we may use different technologies and methods to verify your geographic location. If you do not enable location access on your device, you will not be able to access the ESPN service. Subscriptions to third-party products and services that you purchase or access through your ESPN  subscription will also be subject to specific blackout policies of the applicable sports leagues (e.g., Major League Baseball or the National Hockey League). Such policies may be made available or communicated to you in connection with your purchases of league-specific content.

What is the Streams button?

Fans in the New England Region will see a new “Streams” button displayed for Boston Bruins and Red Sox games airing on NESN. This option will appear on both the ESPN app and ESPN.com. Tapping the Streams button will take you to the equivalent NESN experience (e.g., app or website), where you can sign up for NESN’s subscription service and stream Bruins and Red Sox games. NOTE: Because NESN’s cable channel is only available to fans within the New England Designated Market Area (DMA), the “Streams” button will only be displayed for fans in the New England area. Fans outside New England are geo-restricted and will not see the “Streams” button for NESN games. The Streams button will be enabled in the following sections of the ESPN app and website: - Homefeed - Scores - Gamecast - Red Sox and Bruins Team + League Clubhouses

HOW DOES IT WORK?

For fans in the New England Designated Market Area (DMA) only, the Streams button will appear next to Bruins and Red Sox games on NESN.  All streaming of NESN content takes place within NESN products. ESPN will simply link you to the applicable NESN app/website. Tapping the Streams button launches a menu that enables you to connect to the equivalent NESN experience (see below), sign up for NESN’s subscription service, and stream Bruins and Red Sox games. - Fans using the ESPN app will be directed to the NESN app (or app store if you haven’t already downloaded the NESN app. - Fans using ESPN.com will be directed to NESN.com

HOW TO CONTACT NESN SUPPORT?

Click here to contact NESN Customer Support #### FAQs ##### Why am I not seeing the NESN button? Please verify that you are in the New England DMA. Due to our geo-restriction logic, fans outside of the New England DMA will not see the “Streams” button. ##### Will other networks be included? While we are in discussion with future partners on a similar treatment, the initial marketplace launch will only include NESN. ##### I’m in the right location; why am I not seeing this on my app? Verify that you are on the correct version of the ESPN app. The “Streams” buttons will only be visible to users on version 7.3 and above. ##### What happens if I click on Streams but am NOT a current NESN subscriber? Will I need to subscribe? If so, what if I live outside the region, i.e., I am visiting Boston from Oklahoma? Yes, you will need to subscribe. If you’re located outside of the New England region, you won’t be able to watch NESN content as it’s geo-restricted to New England Designated Market Area users only. ##### What happens if I click on Streams as a current NESN subscriber? You will need to log in with your NESN credentials. Please note that you can only access Streams while in the New England DMA.

Does live streaming on the ESPN app offer Closed Captioning?

What are the minimum system requirements to stream live ESPN content on the desktop?

We recommend the following for the best experience: PC - Processor Speed: Single Core CPU @ 2.4GHz or Dual Core CPU - Memory: 512 MB of RAM (minimum of 256 MB) - Video Memory: 128 MB of Video RAM - Operating System: Windows 8+ - Recommended Browsers: Internet Explorer 9+, Mozilla Firefox 22+, Safari 5, Chrome 28+ - Flash Player: Adobe Flash Player 10.2 or above - Screen Resolution: 1024x768 or higher with 32-bit color - Recommended Connection Speed: 2 Mbps or greater

Mac - Processor Speed: 1.5 GHz - Memory: 512 MB of RAM - Operating System: OS X 10.4+ - Recommended Browsers: Safari 5.0+, Mozilla Firefox 22+, Chrome 28+ - Flash Player: Adobe Flash Player 10.2 or above - Screen Resolution: 1024x768 or higher with 32-bit color - Recommended Connection Speed: 2 Mbps or greater

What is a Blackout? How is my location determined if the event is blacked out?

Blackouts apply to telecasts that have been sold regionally or locally per league, conference and local rightsholder agreements. Regional and local rights holders are usually broadcast stations or regional sports networks. Blackouts are implemented to protect the primary rights holder, as defined by the professional and college sports leagues or teams in a given market. If you are receiving blackout messaging on ESPN, check your local listings to find the television network carrying the event. If you see a message that states, “This content is subject to blackout”, this is because the event that you requested is not available on ESPN in your location. Your location is determined by your IP Address. If you are connecting with a mobile device and believe you are incorrectly receiving blackout messaging, try connecting via WiFi. If you believe that your game is incorrectly blacked out, please open a chat by clicking on the chatbot.

When I launch the ESPN app there a black screen, or nothing happens, or there is no audio/video.

Video can take several seconds to display, or you may be running a content filter, mobile antivirus application, or proxy accelerator that is preventing the streaming of video content. Please turn off these services and try again. If this problem persists, please contact ESPN Fan Support through the Chat link on the bottom right of this page.

Which Roku Players are no longer supported?

The Giga, Paolo, and Jackson models are now considered legacy, which means that they have been discontinued and will no longer receive new versions of the Roku OS.   This includes the following device models: - Roku LT: 2400X/EU - Roku LT: 2450X - Roku HD: 2500X - Roku 2 HD: 3000X - Roku 2 XD: 3050X - Roku 2 XS: 3100X/EU - Roku Streaming Stick: 3400X - Roku Streaming Stick: 3420X

The final firmware version supported by these devices is Roku OS 9.1.

Why am I experiencing blurring of video and/or a loss in sound?

At times, viewers may experience a temporary loss of sound or a blurring of video on ESPN.com. The blurring/muting is required to honor the digital rights ESPN has been granted for the content, which, in rare cases, differ from those rights granted for traditional television usage. If this problem persists, please contact ESPN Customer Care through the Chat link on the bottom right of this page.

Why does an error message display while playing live streaming video on ESPN.com?

Error messages from your video service provider may appear when you attempt to play live streaming video on ESPN.com. Messages appear when there is an issue with your video service/cable subscription. In this case, you should contact your video service/cable provider customer service department for further assistance. If this problem persists, please contact ESPN Customer Care through the Chat link on the bottom right of this page.

Why is my audio and video not in sync?

Make sure that you are not doing anything network-intensive on the same connection, such as downloading or sharing large files, or playing online games. Next, try restarting the video player to see if that resolves the issue. If this problem persists, please contact ESPN Customer Care through the Chat link on the bottom right of this page.

Why is my streaming quality poor or is always freezing or stalling?

If playback stalls, stops or plays slowly, try one or all of the following: - Refresh your browser or close your browser and open it again - Avoid internet congestion by waiting several minutes before viewing the programming again - Close other computer applications that may be open at the same time - If this problem persists, please contact ESPN Customer Care through the Chat link on the bottom right of this page.
