FAQs for the NFL Fantasy Football League Migration to ESPN Fantasy Football

Getting Started

Q: I have an NFL Fantasy account but no ESPN account. What should I expect?

Welcome to ESPN! Start by downloading the ESPN Fantasy app or on the web by accessing https://fantasy.espn.com/football/welcome. Click or select the Import NFL League option. When you are prompted to create an ESPN account, sign up using the same email address you use for your NFL Fantasy account — this will link your leagues automatically and ensure the smoothest transition. NOTES: - IMPORTANT: It can take up to three days to process the migration. - If you use a different email for ESPN, you can enter your NFL Fantasy email address during the import flow; we’ll send you an email to link the two accounts. - If you recently changed the email address associated with your NFL Fantasy account and your leagues don’t appear on ESPN, please use the previous email address associated with your NFL Fantasy account in order to access your leagues.

Q: I already have both an NFL Fantasy and an ESPN account. What should I expect?

Great! If both accounts share the same email address, your NFL Fantasy leagues will be ready to activate as soon as you click Import NFL League and log into your ESPN account. NOTE: Once you are logged in to ESPN, if you use a different email for your NFL Fantasy leagues, you’ll be prompted to enter your NFL Fantasy email — we’ll send a link to connect the two accounts. ##### Q: I’m an NFL Fantasy team manager (not the league manager). How can I see my league on ESPN?  Start by downloading the ESPN Fantasy app or on the web by clicking here. Select the Import NFL League option. Your NFL Fantasy leagues will now be displayed. However, only your league manager can complete the import. If your LM hasn’t started the process yet, click the Notify Commish button to send them a notification to initiate the import. #### League Managers ##### Q: I’m the league manager. How do I import my NFL Fantasy league? Open the ESPN Fantasy app or go to the web (https://fantasy.espn.com/football/welcome) and sign in. Select Import NFL League. If your ESPN and NFL Fantasy accounts share the same email address, your leagues will appear, and you can activate them right away. Once you have migrated your league, you will see league and manager information, including settings, past standings, and league record history. If your league is a Keeper league, team rosters will also be migrated. NOTE: You are the only one who can initiate the import. Team managers can only see the leagues. ##### Q: Our current league manager doesn’t want to play this season. How do we assign a new one and still migrate to ESPN? Sorry to hear that, but the good news is that you can still play! First, the existing LM will need to import the league. Once imported, they can transfer league manager powers to another member. NOTE: This must be done on the web. Once the NFL League has been imported, the current LM must go to League Manager Tools and use the Assign LM Powers option. Click here to view all League Manager FAQs. NOTE: If your LM is unwilling to import the league at all, there’s no self-serve way to transfer LM status outside of ESPN at this time. Please contact ESPN Fan Support, and we will assist in this transfer. You can initiate a chat by clicking on the chatbot icon.

Maintenance Periods

Fantasy Football may be inaccessible during set times throughout the season. They are as follows: - 4 a.m. through 10 a.m. ET (Wednesday) - 4 a.m. through 7 a.m. ET (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday - Sunday)

Network Connection Issues: ESPN Fantasy App

Try these steps in order to identify and fix the issue. Step 1: Verify Your Internet Connection Open Safari (iOS) or Chrome (Android) and go to games.espn.com. If you see an error message, your internet connection is the problem, and the error should indicate the cause. These issues are outside of ESPN’s control, so contact your internet provider if needed. Good to Know: The ESPN Fantasy App requires a moderately strong connection to function. Keep in mind that signal bars on your phone reflect voice/call strength but not the actual speed or reliability of your data connection. Step 2 (iOS Only): Check Cellular Data Settings Make sure Cellular Data is enabled for the ESPN Fantasy App: 1. Open Settings 2. Tap Cellular 3. Scroll down to the app list and find ESPN Fantasy 4. Make sure the toggle is On (green)

Step 3: Try a Different Internet Connection - On Wi-Fi? Try switching to cellular (3G/4G/LTE). - On cellular? Try connecting to a Wi-Fi network instead. - Confirm that other apps or websites load normally on your current connection.

Step 4: Verify Access to the ESPN API In any browser, test your access at http://games.espn.com/ffl/connectivity. If no error messages appear, your device can successfully reach the ESPN API. Step 5: Force-Quit and Reopen the App - iOS: Double-tap the Home button and swipe up on the ESPN Fantasy App. - Android: Open the task manager (long-press Home or use your device’s app switcher) and swipe away the ESPN Fantasy App.

Step 6: Clear the App Cache - iOS: Force-quit the app (Step 5), then go to Settings → Fantasy (look for the rainbow logo) and tap the Reset slider. Relaunch the app. - Android: Force-quit the app (Step 5), then go to App Settings → ESPN Fantasy App and tap Clear Data and Clear Cache. Relaunch the app.

Step 7: Reinstall the App - iOS: Press and hold the app icon, tap the X to uninstall, then reinstall from the App Store. - Android: Uninstall via App Settings, then reinstall from the Play Store.

Still Not Working? If none of these steps help, there may be a larger outage that our team is already working to resolve. Check support.espn.com for the latest updates or open a Chat with ESPN Fan Support by clicking on the icon at the bottom right of this screen.

Fantasy Hockey: Draft

Autopick Draft

What is an Autopick Draft?

The Autopick Draft option automatically drafts players for every team on a scheduled draft date. Team managers do not need to be online during the draft. #### Preparing Your Draft List - Team managers can pre-rank players to improve their chances of building their preferred roster. - Draft lists can be edited until midnight the day before the scheduled draft.

If No Draft List Is Submitted

  • The system will use the default ESPN draft rankings.

How the Autopick Draft Works

When the draft begins: 1. The system loads each team manager’s draft list. 2. For each pick, the system selects the highest-ranked available player from that list. 3. The player must fit an open roster slot and not exceed roster position limits. 4. The process continues until all roster spots for each team are filled.

Autopick Draft: Post Draft

Conclusion of The Draft

  • After the system finishes processing the autopick draft, it requires a few minutes to convert the league to regular-season mode.
  • Team managers will receive an email notifying them when the draft is complete so they can begin managing their team.

Post-Draft

  • The system automatically fills all of the team rosters with each team’s selected players

  • All undrafted players are put on waivers for two days.

  • Team managers can place claims on undrafted players. Once the two-day waiver period ends, the system will automatically execute the pending waiver claims in priority order.

  • When the waiver period ends, all remaining unclaimed players become free agents and can be picked up on a first-come, first-served basis.

  • League Manager leagues’ waiver rules are based on the League Manager’s initial setup and preferences.

Custom Keeper Rounds (LM Leagues)

League managers can manually determine which round and pick a player should be kept in. The League Manager must have their draft set to Snake or Autopick. NOTE: This feature is not available for Salary Cap or Offline drafts. Within Keeper Rules, the League Manager can manually set the Keeper Designated Round. Once this is set, on the Keepers page, the League Manager can click on Edit Keeper Draft Rounds and select whatever round they want each player kept in. IMPORTANT NOTE: The Draft Keepers in the Original Round feature will NOT work with the Random Draft Order setting. The league’s draft order must be manually set by the League Manager to utilize this feature. If a user changes the draft order after setting the rounds players will be kept in, they will be prompted that making this change will revert all of their selections. #### How to Set Custom Keeper Rounds (LM Only / Web Only) NOTE: This setting only works for Keeper leagues in their second and later fantasy years. PRO TIP: Edit your Keeper Draft AFTER the Keeper Selection Lock Time has passed. 1. Click on LM Tools 2. Click on Edit Keepers under Roster Tools 3. You will see each team’s selected Keepers 4. Click on the blue Edit Keeper Draft Rounds button 5. Use the dropdown to select the Round and Pick for each Keeper 6. When finished, click Save Changes.

Draft Dates

  • Teams that join a preseason league will draft on the date listed on the league page
  • Always check the listed draft day and draft type before joining a group
  • In Free Standard Leagues, ESPN reserves the right to merge undrafted leagues if they are not filled by the draft time. Leagues will not be split to complete other leagues in order to run a draft.
  • However, if the number of teams in each league equals five, they can be combined to make one full league (at the discretion of the ESPN Fantasy League Office)

Draft Methods

Draft Overview

Your draft is an important factor for a successful season. Teams that begin with a strong draft are most likely to find themselves in good shape for the rest of the season. #### ESPN Standard Leagues  Each team receives a specified number of players during the draft. For example, in a 10-team league where each team has 9 roster slots each, a total of 90 players will be drafted for that league. In ESPN Standard Leagues, there are two draft options available: - Live Snake draft - Live Salary Cap draft

League Manager Leagues

In League Manager (LM) leagues, your final player total depends on your roster settings. LMs have the option of four different draft methods: - Autopick - Live Online Draft - Offline Draft - Salary Cap Draft

LIVE AND MOCK DRAFT LOBBY LEAGUES

The Live Draft Lobby is where it all starts once you are ready to join a Free Standard or League Manager league. Once you’re there, click on a room name. NOTE: The listed Standard League names are for quick identity purposes only, and will change to generic league names, which you can customize by league vote after the draft is complete. After entering the lobby you will see the “Join This League” button. Another method is to locate a Standard league via the League Directory. NOTE: The listed Standard League names are for quick identity purposes only, and will change to generic league names, which you can customize by league vote after the draft is complete. After entering the lobby you will see the “Join This League” button. A #### WAITING FOR THE DRAFT TO START After you successfully join a lobby league, your team name and info will appear on the page in bold. The league’s draft start time is displayed in the middle of the page and on the countdown clock below it. NOTE: In order for a league draft in the live draft lobby to move into drafting mode, all Open Slots must be filled before the listed draft start time. If open slots remain, try recruiting members to join via the message board or simply wait and hope the room will fill itself in time (the page automatically reloads itself every 30 seconds). Any live draft Lobby league (ESPN created league) that is not full before the draft start will have their draft time continually pushed back in five-minute intervals until the league is filled. NOTE: Once your draft has been filled, it will convert once the scheduled time arrives. #### STARTING THE DRAFT If your league is full at the listed start time the lobby room page will automatically reload itself with a link to Launch Draft. #### THE MOCK DRAFT LOBBY The Mock Draft Lobby is a great way to practice drafting. It works in the same way as the Live Draft Lobby. The only difference is that the Mock Draft does not count! The Mock Draft Lobby can be used for draft practice or testing. We encourage you to try it out and practice drafting from different draft positions (we can’t all get the first draft pick). Good luck with your season!

Draft Schedule Issue

If your draft did not take place at its scheduled time, reference the following steps:

Standard and Custom Leagues

  • In Standard Leagues, the draft will only start once all 8, 10, or 12 team managers join. If one of the team managers forgets to set up their team, your draft cannot start.
  • The missing team manager(s) need to officially join the league and then at least six of your league members need to cast a vote on when the new draft should happen.
  • If you’re in an ESPN Custom League, the same thing applies - a vote is required in order to set up a new draft.

League Manager Leagues

  • Click on the “League Manager Tools” tab if on the web and “League Manager Tools” from the burger in the dropdown if on the app

On the ESPN Fantasy App

  2. Select “Edit Draft Settings”

On the Web

Drafts after the start of the NHL Season

PLEASE NOTE: Using the ‘Reset Draft’ feature will delete scores and stats for the current season. Previous scores and matchups cannot be adjusted and the scoring will NOT be retroactive. - Types of Leagues

H2H Leagues

The 2025-2026 NHL season begins on October 7th. If your H2H league draft ends before the start of the first game of the day on Oct 7th (5:00PM ET), your league’s season will include stats from the first week of the fantasy season. All H2H league drafts ending after the start of the first game of the day on Oct 7th (5:00PM ET) will start their season at the start of the next full H2H match-up. #### See the examples provided below. Scenario 1 Your league draft time was on September 27, at 6 PM ET. The draft ended at 8:00 PM ET The first game of the season starts at 5:00 PM ET on October 7. Since your draft ended before the start of the season, your league will start the first week of the fantasy season. Scenario 2 Your league draft time was on October 7, at 4:00 PM ET. The draft ended at 5:30 PM ET. The first game of the season started at 5:00 PM ET on October 7 Even though your draft started before 5:00 PM on October 7th, the draft ended after the first game started. This will result in your league’s season starting at the next Head-to-Head matchup (October 13th -19th) The previous match-up will not be retroactively scored. Scenario 3 Your league draft time was on October 14, at 8 PM ET. The draft ended at 10 PM ET. The first game of the season started at 5:00 PM ET on Oct 7. Since your draft ended after the first game of the season, and after the start of the first game of the current matchup, your season will start at the next Head-to-Head matchup (October 20th - 26th). Previous match-ups will not be retroactively scored. #### Roto/Season Points Leagues If your Roto/Season Points league draft ends before the start of the first game of the season, your league’s season will start on the first day of the season. If your Roto/Season Points league draft ends after the start of the first game of the season, the start of your league’s season scoring will begin the day after your draft. Roto League Scenario Your league draft time is on October 7th, at 8 PM ET. The draft ended at 10 PM ET. Since your league drafted after the start of the first game of the day, your season will start on the next day with NHL games, which is October 8. Previous scores will not be retroactively scored.

Enable/Disable Draft Pick Trading: LM Leagues

The League Manager (LM) is the only person who can enable or disable Draft Pick Trading in a league. Draft Pick Trading allows team managers to trade draft slots before the draft begins. Example: A manager might trade their 2nd- and 3rd-round picks to another manager in exchange for that manager’s 1st-round pick. Draft pick trades can be completed on both the ESPN Fantasy App and the web. Note: Draft pick trades can only be made before the draft and apply only to the current season. #### Enabling Draft Pick Trading 1. Go to LM Tools. 2. Select Edit Draft Settings. 3. Set Draft Order to Manually Set by League Manager. 4. Set Allow Draft Pick Trading to Yes. 5. Click Save Changes.

Alternative method: 1. Go to LM Tools. 2. Select Begin Draft Pick Trading. 3. Click Allow Draft Pick Trading and Confirm.

Disabling Draft Pick Trading

  1. Go to LM Tools.
  2. Select Stop Draft Pick Trading and Reset Draft Picks.
  3. Click Confirm.
Important Note

When Draft Pick Trading is disabled: - All traded draft picks are returned to their original teams. - Any players traded along with those picks will remain on their current teams.

To move those players back, the League Manager must manually adjust rosters using LM Tools.

In the Live Online Snake Draft, each team’s manager drafts unique players via a back-and-forth, round-by-round draft order (i.e., 1-10, 10-1, 1-10, 10-1, etc.) until all roster slots are full. Like any prospective team manager, you want to assemble the best possible roster of players, so it’s smart to be prepared before you set out. The following information will brief you on the ins-and-outs of how the Snake Draft works: #### Editing Draft Lists - We highly recommend that all live draft participants customize their draft list before the actual draft. This protects you in case you are unable to participate in your live draft. - The Player list can be reordered using our Pre-Rank tool.  You can also determine which position to draft each round with the Draft Strategy tool.  Both are available on your preseason “My Team” page.  PRO-TIP: Make sure you SAVE your changes before you leave! - NOTE: You may edit your draft list as often as you like, up until one hour before your scheduled draft time.

  1. On your preseason League Office page in the “Draft Info” box.
  2. On your main team page.

If a league is not full, it will NOT convert into draft mode, and the draft time will be rescheduled.IMPORTANT: League Managers, make sure that all of your league’s team managers have joined the league at least one hour before your draft! If not, then you will have to select a new Draft Date/Time.

Salary Cap Draft

Salary Cap Drafts use a competing-offer format and differ considerably from traditional Snake Live Drafts. In Salary Cap Drafts, two first-round ranked players could be signed by the same team, which would rarely happen in a Snake Draft, because both players are so early and close to one another in the Snake Draft ranking order. For example, in ESPN Fantasy Baseball, it’s possible to get Shohei Ohtani and Aaron Judge on the same team in a Salary Cap Draft, but that is almost impossible to achieve in a Snake or Auto-draft. - Private league LMs can edit the budget under draft settings. - Salary Cap drafts are available to Standard (Public)  and League Manager (LM) Leagues. - Teams can sign any player, provided they have the funds available. - Public leagues are set up with a preset $200 budget to sign enough players to fill their rosters.

NOTE: ALL teams will start the draft with the same budget. If you are in a keeper league and have different “salaries” for keepers, please visit “Keeper Leagues.” - To edit draft settings pre-draft, please visit “Pre-Draft League Manager Abilities.” - To edit in-draft settings, please visit “Salary Cap Draft- League Manager Tools.”

Process:

  1. Once a player is nominated for signing, the offer process begins.
  2. Team managers can offer any monetary value that their budget permits.
  3. Team managers continue to submit offers until only a single high-salary offer remains. The system will then alert team managers, and the winning team will have the winning salary amount deducted from their budget.
  4. This process repeats until EVERY team’s roster is completely filled.
  5. When the draft is complete, the league will move into “in-season” mode, where teams can start making roster moves, waiver claims, trades, etc.

NOTE: Unused budgets DO NOT carry over into* “in-season”* mode. There is no advantage in finishing the draft with a remaining budget!

Salary Cap Draft - In-draft League Manager Tools

In customizable, private leagues, League Managers (LMs) have full commissioner controls over the league, including draft admin functions at any time during the draft. These admin functions can be accessed in the “League Manager” tab in the LM’s main window. The LM can perform the following draft functions if the draft is paused: 1. Pause Draft: LMs can pause the draft at any time. If the LM pauses the draft, the offering clock will stop and the app will display a “Draft is Paused” message. Once the LM resumes the draft, the clock will start for the current offer (image: Hockey_-Salary_Cap_draft-Pause.png) 2. Allow managers that have disconnected to remain off autopick until the time allowed for their pick has expired: Choosing this settings would allow more time for managers that are not present more time to join the draft.  (image: Hockey-Salary_Cap_draft-_allow_off_autopick.png) 3. Configure Time: LMs have the ability to set the time per each nomination and offer. The system default is 30 seconds. Once the draft is resumed the new time configurations will be in place.

Nominations:  (image: Hockey_-Salary_Cap_draft-time_to_offer.png) Offers: (image: Hockey-Salary_Cap_draft-time_to_nominate.png) 4. Reset Draft (on the web only):  LMs have the ability to “reset” the draft at any time. In the case that the draft is reset, all picks reversed and the league will be back to exactly where they were prior to draft.  (image: Hockey-Snake_Draft-reset.png) 5. Undo Picks: LMs have the ability to “undo” any picks during any rounds. If the draft is in 3rd round and LM decides to undo a pick from the 1st round, doing so will also undo any picks that occurred after this pick was made. (image: Hockey-Salary_Cap_draft-_undo.png)

Salary Cap Draft: Absentee Team Managers

It is strongly recommended that all team managers be present when the draft begins. #### If Team Managers Are Missing - If one or two managers are missing, the League Manager should pause the draft and attempt to contact them. - If three or more managers are missing, it is recommended to reset the draft for a later time when more managers can attend.

How Auto Draft Works for Absent Managers

  • Any team whose manager is not present will be placed on Auto.
  • The system will actively draft players on their behalf.

During Auto drafting: - The system may offer up to a randomly determined percentage of the player’s preset salary limit. - If no salary limit is preset, the system will use the default value.

This ensures that absent team managers can still build a competitive team. #### If a Manager Gets Disconnected - If a team manager loses connection during the draft, their team will automatically switch to Auto mode.

Salary Cap Draft: League Manager Tools

In League Manager leagues, League Managers (LMs) have full commissioner controls over the league, including draft admin functions at any time during the draft. These admin functions can be accessed in the “LM Tools” tab in the LM’s main window. The LM can perform the following draft functions if the draft is paused: #### Pause Draft LMs can pause the draft at any time. If the LM pauses the draft the countdown clock stops. The app displays a “Draft is Paused” message. Once the LM resumes the draft, the clock will start for the current offer. #### Configure Time LMs can set the time for each nomination and offer. The system default for both is 30 seconds and can be changed by 5-second increments. Once the draft is resumed, the new time configurations will be in place. #### Reset Draft (on the web only) LMs can “reset” the draft at any time. If the draft is reset, the Salary Cap draft will start over from scratch: all players returned, all winning offers refunded, all picks reversed. #### Undo Picks LMs have the ability to “undo” any picks during any rounds. If the draft is in the 5th round and LM decides to undo a 2nd-round pick, doing so will also undo any picks made after that pick.

Salary Cap Drafts - How to Draft

Things to Know for Salary Cap Drafts

Nominating a Player
  • Team managers have 30 seconds to nominate a player.
  • To nominate, select a player from the main Players table (shows the player’s image and stats).
  • If no player is selected within 30 seconds, the system auto-nominates in this order:

Top player in the Player Queue panel (if any) - The available player with the highest starting salary - The default nomination offer is $1. - The nominating manager can raise the offer before submitting.

What Happens After a Nomination
  • Once nominated, the player appears at the top of the screen (with profile and stats) under the list of team managers.
  • The countdown clock begins immediately.
Making Offers
  • The offer clock starts at 30 seconds.
  • Any offer made with 10 seconds or less remaining will reset the clock back to 10 seconds. This continues until the player is won.

Offers can be placed in two ways: - +1 bidding - Entering a custom dollar amount

The app includes two buttons for submitting an offer (depending on how you’re bidding). ##### Offer Limits and Max Bids - The current offer is shown on the right and will also indicate whether you’re winning. - Teams can only bid amounts that still allow them to fill the rest of their roster with at least $1 per remaining roster slot. - You can view a team’s maximum offer by hovering over the team jerseys. - The maximum offer can also be displayed via an option in the Options tab. - Once a team reaches its max offer:

The app will reject additional bids - Offer buttons will be grayed out

Snake Draft Settings for LM leagues

In League Manager (custom) leagues, League Managers (LMs) have full commissioner controls over the league, including draft admin functions at any time during the draft. These admin functions can be accessed in the “LM Tools” tab in the LM’s main window. The LM can perform the following draft functions if the draft is paused: 1. Pause Draft:  LMs can pause the draft at any time. If the LM pauses the draft, the countdown clock stops, and the app displays a “Draft is Paused” message. Once the LM resumes the draft, the clock will start for the current offer. 2. Allow managers who have disconnected to remain off autopick until their allotted pick time expires. Choosing these settings would allow more time for managers who are not present more often to join the draft. 3. Configure Time:  LMs can set the time per pick. The system default is 30 seconds. Once the draft is resumed, the new time configurations will be in place. 4. Make picks for other managers (draft on behalf of missing managers) Use this to draft for managers who could not attend the draft (or LM can let the system autopick; it’s all up to the LM!). The league will see a message indicating LM is picking on behalf of someone, then the LM can proceed to the Players tab and pick. 5. Reset Draft (on the web only):  LMs can “reset” the draft at any time.  NOTE for Salary Cap Drafts: If a Salary Cap draft is reset, the draft will start over from scratch: all players are returned to teh draft pool, all winning offers are refunded, and all picks are reversed as if the draft never happened. 6. Undo picks LMs have the ability to “undo” any picks during any rounds. If the draft is in the 5th round and LM decides to undo a 2nd-round pick, doing so will also undo any picks made after that pick.

Trade Draft Picks

Draft Pick Trading enables Team Managers to trade draft slots - for example, a team manager might trade their 2nd and 3rd round pick slots to another team manager for their 1st round pick slot in return. Trades can be performed on the ESPN Fantasy App and on the web. NOTE: Draft Pick Trading is only available if it is enabled by the LM. #### Trade Draft Picks on the ESPN Fantasy App ##### Trade Draft Picks in a Non-Keeper League - Go to “Opposing Teams” and select the team you want to trade with - Click on “Propose Trade - Propose the draft pick trade

Note: If you trade and receive a net total of draft picks greater than the number of rounds in the draft (i.e., more players than you have roster slots for), your draft will end once you’ve reached the maximum, and you won’t be able to select any more players. If you have traded away multiple picks but not received as many in return, you will end the draft with empty roster slots and be required to fill via Free Agency after the draft has finished. Draft pick trading is available until one hour before your draft. ##### Trade Draft Picks in a Keeper League - Draft pick trades can be made as a swap of picks or as a combination of keepers and picks. Draft pick trades can only be done prior to the Keeper deadline for League Manager LeaguesThe Keeper deadline is determined by League Managers

Trade Draft Picks On the Web

Trade Draft Picks in a Non-Keeper League
  • Go to the “Opposing Teams” menu and select the team you want to trade with
  • Click on “Propose Trade”.
  • Propose the draft pick trade
Trade Draft Picks In a Keeper League
  • Draft pick trades can be made as a straight-up swap of picks or as a combination of keepers and picks. Draft pick trades can only be done prior to the Keeper deadline for League Manager Leagues
  • You are trading for a team manager’s pick in a given round, not the pick itself
  • If there’s no assurance that your League Manager won’t switch the draft order, it might be wise to avoid making such a trade. Otherwise, that 2nd overall pick you thought you traded for could become the 10th pick just like that

Waiting For Your Draft to Start (Live Draft Lobby)

After you join a lobby league, your team name and info will appear on the page in bold The league’s draft start time is displayed in the middle of the page and on the countdown clock below it - In order for a Standard or League Manager League draft to move into drafting mode, all open slots must be filledIf open spots remain, try recruiting more friends to join your league, or wait until others join

Starting the Draft - If your league is full at the listed start time, the lobby room page will automatically reload itself with a link to launch draft

Adding and Removing Bench and IR/IL Slots (LM Only)

League Managers are able to add Bench and IR/IL slots post-draft (no removing slots once added) to their league’s Roster setting. This applies to Bench and IR/IL slots only—all other position slots remain locked (no adding or removing). To Add/Remove a Bench or IR Roster Slot (LM Only / Web Only) 1. Click on LM Tools 2. Click on Edit Roster Settings under Roster Tools 3. Scroll down to Bench and** IR/IL** and adjust the number as desired 4. Click on** Save Changes**

Adjust Scoring (LM Only)

IMPORTANT NOTE: Changing the scores of a matchup should never be done lightly. We strongly suggest discussing it with your league before doing so in order to avoid drama. - Adjust Scoring is only available in LEAGUE MANAGER H2H points league - The Adjust Scoring feature can be accessed from the “LM Tools” and “Scoreboard” pages. This feature allows the League Manager to add or subtract points from a team on a given week. - If the score adjustment changes the matchup results (e.g., from a win to a loss), the standings page will automatically update to reflect the adjusted results. - If the adjustment is made to a game, the box score page will reflect the change with an asterisk. - To adjust the scores, click on the “Scoreboard” tab and then “Adjust Scoring” in the scoreboard of whichever game you wish to edit.

Bonus Wins and Losses (LM Leagues Only)

Bonus Wins and Losses is a setting in League Manager (LM) leagues only that rewards teams that may score a ton of points but face high-scoring teams more often than not. LMs can activate this scoring setting to award an additional Win or Loss based on a team’s matchup score versus the rest of the league. - If the team’s scoring matchup places them in the top half of the league for that week, that team will receive an extra Win. - If that team’s matchup score for the week is in the bottom half of the rest of the league for that week, the team will receive an additional loss.

To Activate Bonus Wins and Losses

  1. Click on LM Tools
  2. Click on League Settings under League and Scoring Settings Tools
  3. Click on** Edit** in the Regular Season Setup section
  4. Check the box next to Bonus Wins and Losses
  5. Click Save Changes

You cannot edit the number of divisions after the draft. - Multiple Divisions will affect your playoff schedule. League Manager leagues are private/invite-only

  • Draft Time: Select from the available time slots (hour/minute). If a particular time slot is unavailable, all slots at that time are taken. However, if a league changes its time or is deleted, time slots may open up

*****Make sure all your settings are entered correctly because after they are submitted, they can only be changed with a league vote (via the League Referenda)

Delete Your League (LM Only)

Only the League Manager who created the league (the League Creator) can delete it. While the League Creator can assign LM powers to other Team Managers, their powers are limited. Deleting a league that has conducted a draft is a serious decision, as league deletion is final and can NOT be reversed by anyone, including ESPN! #### To Delete Your League (Web Only) 1. Click on LM Tools 2. Click on Delete League under League and Scoring Settings ToolsYou will be presented with a** confirmation pop-up. This pop-up warns that deleting a league is final and cannot be reversed. 3. Click on the red Delete League** button to continue the deletion process.Another pop-up will confirm your decision to delete your league.  This is the last chance to change your mind. 4. Click on** Confirm** to delete your league. All league information will be deleted and can not be recovered or restored by anyone, including ESPN. 5. Your league will disappear in a few minutes.

Fair Play/Conduct (Collusive Transactions)

Collusive Transactions: When one team makes moves to benefit another team without trying to improve its own position. - An example of collusive transactions is one-sided trades or dropping a player so another team can pick up that player. - Teams found in violation of this policy will be canceled and their team managers prohibited from participating in future ESPN Fantasy Games. - Standard league members are expected to veto/protest all unfair/collusive trades. Four votes are required in a Standard league for a trade to be denied. - ​In League Manager leagues, a different veto system may be in place to veto all trades. For more information on vetoing trades, click here.

Fair Play/Conduct (Multiple Teams)

Fair Play and Conduct

  • One person cannot manage more than one team in the same league.
  • If two or more teams in the same league are under the same account, the teams must be controlled by different people sharing an account.
  • Violations of this will lead to disqualifications of teams from the league and cancellations of the teams.

How do I create a League Message?

League Message Boards are only available in League Manager (LM) leagues. IMPORTANT NOTE: Even though LM leagues are private, everyone is still accountable for adhering to the ESPN Fair Play and Conduct Policy. 1. Tap on your league from the League Directory. 2. You will then see a list of conversations in that League. 3. To add a direct or group conversation, tap the create message icon and select one or more league mates to create a private conversation.

Inactive Team Managers

The commissioner may contact team managers of teams that remain inactive for extended periods of time. - The League Manager will send notifications to the email on record for the inactive team manager. - If the account still remains inactive after the email was sent by the League Manager, the League Manager reserves the right to reassign team managership of the inactive team.

Sending Invites for League Manager Leagues - ESPN Fantasy App - ESPN.com Website - Other methods available

Invite team managers to a League Manager League via the ESPN Fantasy App

  2. Click on “Edit team managers”

Other Methods of Inviting Team Managers

  1. League Invite Link: League Managers can copy/paste the invite link to the league located on the Members page and post it on a message board, blog, chat, or personal email. Anyone who uses the link can join the league on a first-come, first-served basis until the league is full.
  2. Email Invite: Email invites provide each recipient with a unique link through which they can join your league. Only your League Manager can designate who is invited. Invites can be sent out by entering each email address into the “New Invitations” textbox.

Issues Joining a League

If you’re having issues joining your league, there are a few steps you can take:

  • Try telling your League Manager to resend the invitation to your email address. If you still don’t receive an email in your inbox, try an alternate email address
  • Be sure to check your spam and junk folders, as it may have been bounced in there by mistake. If so, add espnfantasy@fantasygames.com to your contact list

Received an Invite But Can’t Join League:

  • If you received an invite from your League Manager, but the page said you couldn’t join the league when you clicked the URL, don’t worry - your League Manager likely changed your email address after inviting you, thereby voiding the invitation. Talk with your League Manager and make sure you have the right email address in place

Keeper Leagues

Keeper leagues (also known as Dynasty leagues) allow Team Managers to keep players on their roster over multiple seasons without having to redraft them.  Keepers are only available in League Manager leagues.  Team Managers may select as few players or as many players as the league creator selected during league creation. For example, if your league allows 3 Keepers per team, a Team Manager may elect to designate between 0-3 players to stay on their roster for the next season. League Manager can enable or disable Keeper settings via LM Tools. #### A few important facts about Keepers on ESPN Fantasy:  - The default draft method in Keeper leagues is to draft/assign selected Keepers in the first rounds.  Keeper rounds are Non-Snake. (For Snake Drafts) This means that if the league allows 2 keepers in the upcoming draft, the first 2 rounds would be non-snake. 1-10, 1-10, then from the 3rd round, 1-10, 10-1, 1-10, etc.

  • Example: Last season, a Team Manager drafted a player in the 5th round.  The Team Manager decides to mark that player as one of their team’s Keepers for the next season.  When the next season’s draft occurs, that Keeper will be drafted automatically in the 5th round.

To enable Keepers in an LM league:

  1. Open** LM Tools**
  2. Go to League and Scoring Settings Tools
  3. Select League Settings
  4. Select** Transactions and Keepers**
  5. Scroll down to Keepers Rules and click on Edit
  6. Click on Yes for Use Keepers for (next) Season.
  7. You can now select how many players can be designated as a Keeper (Minimum 1, maximum full roster size)
  8. You can set the date when Keepers Lock. The default is one hour before your next season Draft Date/Time.
  9. Click Save Changes

Keeper Salaries

Keeper salaries are how much a manager will “pay for” out of their salary cap prior to the draft in order to keep that player. Kind of how draft right works.  Most leagues use the player salaries from the prior season(s), but LM’s can change that. ##### To Edit Keeper Salaries 1. Open** LM Tools 2. Go to League and Scoring Settings Tools 3. Select League Settings 4. Select Transactions and Keepers 5. Scroll down to Keepers Rules and click on Edit 6. Click on Edit Keeper Salaries. 7. You can now select the salary. 8. Click Save Changes**

Change Keeper Lock Date

NOTE: Once the keeper lock date passes, only the league manager will be able to modify a team’s keeper selection.  Alternatively, choose “Lock One Hour before Draft” to allow league members to edit their keepers in the last minute. 1. Open** LM Tools 2. Go to League and Scoring Settings Tools 3. Select League Settings 4. Select Transactions and Keepers 5. Scroll down to Keepers Rules and click on Edit 6. You can set the date when Keepers Lock. The default is one hour before your next season Draft Date/Time. 7. Click Save Changes**

League ID

Important Note: If you are unable to find your League ID and need help locating it, please contact your other league members, as this is the best alternative method to find your League ID.

What is a League ID? 

A League ID is the unique numeric identifier for your league among all ESPN Fantasy leagues. While there are millions of individual leagues, this League ID helps locate your exact league for any troubleshooting you may need. It is very important that you note and keep safe any IDs for the leagues you’re part of, whether public or private. #### Why do I need my League ID? A league ID can be used to locate a league among others when the account email has been lost/compromised. This ID can be used by ESPN Fan Support staff to locate leagues and investigate reported issues. Without the League ID, ESPN cannot guarantee we can locate your league among the millions of others in the system. Keep your league ID in a safe location for future reference, if needed. #### Where can I find a League ID? The League ID can be found in multiple spots. #### Traditional Web Browser - ESPN.com (image: league_ID.png) - 1. Email, text, or direct link invites: - Locate the email, click “join this league”.  A new window will appear from fantasy.espn.com - Within the URL bar of the new window will be LeagueID=

  • Locate the invite message
  • Within the link, you will be able to find LeagueID=

On the ESPN Fantasy App (iOS or Android)

  • Access your league under the “League” tab.
  • Click “League Info”
  • League ID is available to view.

League Setting Lock Time

League Setting Lock Time

The table below covers the times during the season when specific league setting features lock and cannot be edited, even by your League Manager. The most common request is how to change the draft date/time. Visit hereto learn how to change a draft date/time. - League Setup: These settings cannot be changed after you confirm your league settings. - Draft: These settings can only be edited before the league’s draft begins. - Season Start: These settings can only be edited before the season starts. - Playoff Start: These settings can only be edited before the league’s playoffs begin (H2H Only). - End of Season: These settings can be edited throughout the full season. - Never Locks: These settings can be changed at any time during the season.

  • BASIC SETTINGS: LOCKS
  • League Name:: Never Locks
  • Scoring Type:: Draft
  • Number of teams in league:: Your Draft
  • ROSTER SETTINGS: LOCKS
  • Roster Slots%:: Your Draft
  • Positional Limits*:: Never Locks
  • Game Start Limits*:: Never Locks
      • Limits can be increased or decreased and will affect previous scoring accordingly. % - Number of Bench& IR slots can be increased during the season but can NOT be decreased.
  • SCORING SETTINGS: LOCKS
  • Scoring Categories/Points Settings*:: Never Locks
      • Any changes will impact league standings retroactive to the start of the season.
  • LEAGUE RULES: LOCKS
  • Player Universe:: Your Draft
  • Observe Undroppable Players List:: Never Locks
  • Make League Viewable to Public:: Never Locks
  • Lineup Changes:: Your Draft
  • Roster Locktime:: Your Draft
  • Player Acquisition System:: Your Draft
  • Free Agent/Waiver Acquisition Limit*:: Never Locks
  • Waiver Period:: Never Locks
  • Trade Limit:: Never Locks
  • Trade Deadline:: Never Locks
  • Trade Review Period:: Never Locks
  • Votes Required to Veto Trade:: Never Locks
      • When eliminating waivers, any player who is on waivers due to being dropped from a team’s roster will remain on waivers until the following day.
  • DIVISION & TEAM SETTINGS: LOCKS
  • Division Settings (H2H Only):: Your Draft
  • Team Names & team managers:: Never Locks
  • SCHEDULE/PLAYOFFS SETTINGS (H2H ONLY): LOCKS
  • Weeks per Regular Season Matchup:: Season Start
  • Weeks in Regular Season:: Playoff Start
  • Matchup Tie Breaker:: Playoff Start
  • Teams/Weeks in Playoffs:: Playoff Start
  • Weeks per Playoff Matchup:: Playoff Start
  • NOTE: When adding teams or weeks to the playoff schedule, if the regular-season schedule needs to be shortened, matchups at the end of the regular season will be dropped from the schedule. Similarly, when adding weeks to the regular-season schedule, matchups will be added at the end of the regular season and all teams will be on bye weeks. It is the League Manager’s responsibility to edit such matchups.
  • KEEPER RULES: LOCKS
  • Current Season Keeper Settings:: Your Draft
  • Next Season Keepers Settings:: Never Locks
  • DRAFT SETTINGS: LOCKS
  • Draft Type:: Your Draft
  • Draft Date:: Your Draft
  • Draft Pick Trading:: Your Draft
  • Reset Draft:: End of Season

  • Draft Order:: Your Draft

League Types in ESPN Fantasy

ESPN Fantasy offers two primary league types: Standard Leagues and League Manager (LM) Leagues. The main difference between these league types is who controls the league settings and rules. #### Quick Comparison - Feature: Standard League: League Manager League - League control: ESPN: League Manager - Rule customization: Not available: Fully customizable - Draft setup: Automatic: Controlled by LM - Ideal for: Quick public leagues: Private or custom leagues

Standard Leagues

Standard Leagues are public leagues with preset rules managed by ESPN. These leagues are designed for players who want a quick and simple way to start playing without customizing league settings. ##### Key Characteristics - League rules and scoring are set by ESPN - League operations are automatically managed - Drafts are scheduled automatically - Roster sizes and scoring formats follow standard settings for that sport

Standard leagues are ideal for players who want a ready-to-play fantasy experience. #### League Manager (LM) Leagues League Manager leagues are custom leagues created and controlled by a player, known as the League Manager (LM). The League Manager controls most league settings and can customize the league to suit a specific group or style of play. LM leagues are commonly used by friends, families, coworkers, or established fantasy groups. ##### Customization Options League Managers can adjust settings such as: - Scoring format - Roster size and lineup settings - Draft type and draft schedule - Waiver rules and free agency settings - Trade rules and review process - Playoff format

Some leagues may also use advanced features, including: - Keeper leagues (players can be retained for future seasons) - Offline drafts - Other custom rule configurations

Overall League Participation Limits

Each ESPN Fantasy account can join up to 25 leagues per sport, including both Standard and League Manager leagues. #### Quick Tip If you’re unsure which league type you’re in, check the League Settings page. If the league has a League Manager listed, it is a League Manager League.

Leave a League or Remove a Team Manager

Sometimes you may need to relinquish management of a team. You can always leave your team BEFORE the league draft.  Things get trickier after the draft has occurred. In Public Leagues, you may not leave once the draft has completed.  In League Manager leagues, you can leave your team, but you will need to ask your LM to remove you as a Team Manager. - Click the** Leave League** link on your team page** *****before the league’s draft.***Team managers can’t leave a league after the draft occurs.

How to Remove a Team Manager (LM only / Web Only) - Open** LM Tools. - Click on League Membership Tools. - Click on Edit Managers and Send Invitations. - Click on the red Remove Manager** button to the right of the Team Manager to be removed. - You will be prompted to** sign in** again for confirmation. - You will then need to confirm the removal by clicking on Remove Manager from the pop-up.

Making a Private League Viewable to the Public (LM Only)

By default, all League Manager Leagues are Private.  This means that only members of that league can view it. League managers can set their league to public. Public leagues can be viewed by anyone at any time. NOTE: All leagues, Public and Private, Standard and League Manager are obligated to adhere to the ESPN Rules of Conduct and Fair Play. Please review Offensive Content and Team Managers . Important: Making your league viewable does not make it joinable. All League Manager leagues remain private — this setting only controls whether non-members can view certain pages via a shared link. It can be changed at any time during the season. Pages non-members can view (when given a direct URL): - League Office, Standings, Box Scores, and Team Pages.

Pages that are always private, regardless of this setting: - The list of team managers and league message boards is never visible to non-members.

To make a League Public or Private (Web Only):

  1. Go to the** League** tab
  2. Click Settings
  3. Click Basic Settings
  4. Click Edit Basic Settings
  5. Set the public viewability option to Yes to allow non-members to view league pages when given a direct URL (such as one shared via email or a message board)
  6. Click on Save Changes

Offensive Content and Team Managers

ESPN Fantasy Sports are available to everyone with the understanding that we are here for fun. However, a distinction must be made between playful banter between competitors and abuse/hostility.  ALL leagues, ESPN Standard and League Manager, both Public and Private, are subject to the ESPN Terms of Use** and Fair Play and Conduct when playing Fantasy games on ESPN. #### Team managers are expected to communicate in a respectful and gracious manner** - Threats and obscenities are against the rules and are illegal in many jurisdictions. - Team managers who send threatening emails to another team manager will be warned and/or kicked out of the game and can be banned from ESPN.com altogether. - Threats and obscenities are not allowed at any time.

Offensive language, league, or team names are prohibited

  • Any posts, including league and team names, that are derogatory in nature are strictly prohibited. This restriction includes chat rooms, message boards, and the league’s bulletin board.
  • There is a zero-tolerance level concerning offensive posts, including personal attacks, sexist remarks, and/or racist remarks.

Violators of the above rules are subject to being banned from ESPN.com and/or Disney sites. Furthermore, violations containing threats may be referred to the appropriate authorities.

Position Eligibility

  • The NHL sends ESPN an updated list of every player’s position eligibility, including rookies, prior to the start of each season.
  • ESPN reserves the right to designate a different position for a player.
  • Once the season has begun, ESPN cannot change the primary position. However, a player can gain additional eligibility for other positions during the season if circumstances warrant it. *****
  • League Managers DO NOT have the ability to change a player’s position.

***  Under certain circumstances, ESPN reserves the right to change a player’s primary position. NOTE**: It’s important to note that roster minimums and maximums within your league’s settings relate to the primary position only (the first position listed next to a player), not any secondary positions granted.

Regular Season and Playoffs Schedule in Standard Leagues

REGULAR SEASON SCHEDULE

All Standard Leagues play with a fixed 22 matchup regular season. To view your team’s schedule click on the “Schedule” link on your main team page. To view any individual matchup period click on the main “Scoreboard” tab (it will default to the current period). NOTE: The Standard League Trade Deadline is Friday, February 27, 2026 9:00 AM PST. #### REACHING THE PLAYOFFS #### The top four teams in a league make the playoffs. These four are comprised of the two division champs and two wild-card teams. Division champs are the teams that win the league divisions. The next two teams, according to the tie-breaker below, are the wild card teams. 

PLAYOFF BRACKET SETUP The Head-to-Head fantasy playoffs take place during the last four (4) weeks of fantasy play. To view your league’s playoff bracket, click on the “Playoff Bracket” link on the “Scoreboard” tab. The playoffs start on NHL Week 22 and run through NHL Week 25 of the season (4 weeks). Round 1 takes place during Weeks 22 and 23 (two weeks), and Round 2 takes place during Weeks 24 and 25 (two weeks). #### PLAYOFF SEEDING AND TIEBREAKERS (Standard Leagues) When your league converts into playoff mode the system automatically generates a seed for each team in the league based on the regular season results. The seeds determine where the system places each team in the playoffs. The primary factors which determine seeds are: 1. Division Winner(s) 2. Winning Percentage

In the event that two or more teams have the same winning percentage at the conclusion of the regular season, and have played the same number of head-to-head games between them, the following tiebreaking system determines the seed: 1. Overall record 2. Head-to-Head record 3. Division record 4. Coin Flip

winning percentage.

In the event that two or more teams have the same winning percentage at the conclusion of the regular season, and have NOT played the same number of head-to-head games between them, the following tiebreaking system determines seed: 1. Overall record 2. Division record 3. Coin Flip

SCORING DURING THE PLAYOFFS

Scoring during the playoffs works much the same way as during the regular season, with the object to win as many categories as possible. The big difference is that each playoff round lasts two weeks, not one week (as during the regular season). As such the Games Started Limits are increased and you get two full weeks to accumulate stats in each stat category. By winning 6 or more of the 10 categories during each playoff matchup you’ll guarantee yourself a win. In the event that two teams have the same win-loss-tie record at the conclusion of their two-week playoff game, the following tie-breaking system is employed: Note: During the playoffs, once your matchup ends, the scoring is final and no scoring corrections will be applied. #### Tie Breaker for Playoff Games - Higher seeded team

HOME ICE ADVANTAGE

In all cases, the higher-seeded team will have the home-field advantage throughout the entire playoff round. 

All Standard leagues play with a fixed 21-week regular season. After that, the playoffs begin! To view your team’s schedule click on the “Schedule” link on your main team page. To view any individual matchup period, click on the main “Scoreboard” tab (it will default to the current period). #### PLAYOFF SCHEDULE In Round One of the playoffs, the division winner with the best win/loss record plays the wild-card team with the worst win/loss record; the other division winner plays the wild-card team with the better win/loss record. In Round Two, the winners of Round One (see table below) compete for the League Championship. Each round of the playoffs spans a two-week period. The remaining teams in each league compete in the consolation bracket. From the League Championship bracket: - 1st place - Winner of game 1, round 2 - 2nd place - Loser of game 1, round 2 - 3rd place - Winner of game 2, round 2 - 4th place - Loser of game 2, round 2

From the Consolation bracket: - 5th place - Winner of game 1, round 2 - 6th place - Loser of game 1, round 2 - 7th place - Winner of game 2, round 2 - 8th place - Loser of game 2, round 2 - 9th place - Winner of game 3, round 2 - 10th place - Loser of game 3, round 2

Scoring Formats

STANDARD SCORING FORMATS (Free) 

Standard leagues have five scoring formats available during league creation: These are the most commonly used scoring formats in fantasy baseball are Rotisserie and Head-to-Head: Each Category. The five formats are defined below. #### LEAGUE MANAGER LEAGUE SCORING FORMATS  League Manager leagues can be created using one of five different scoring formats. These formats can be further customized by the league creator by tweaking individual categories and points. The five formats are defined below: - Rotisserie - Head-to-Head: Points - Head-to-Head: Each Category - Head-to-Head: Most Categories - Season Points

Rotisserie

Rotisserie, or “Roto,” is the most common way to play fantasy baseball. In this scoring type, teams are ranked from first to last in each statistical category. Points are then awarded according to the order in each category and totaled to determine an overall score and league rank. #### Head-to-Head: Points H2H Points is very similar to how fantasy football is played. It allows you to assign a point value to individual statistic categories (e.g., HR=4, RBI=1), and each scoring period’s winner is determined solely by which team accumulates the most fantasy points against a single opponent. The end result is a win (1-0-0), loss (0-1-0), or tie (0-0-1). If selected, your league will have team schedules/playoffs, and you will have the option to set up divisions. #### Head-to-Head: Each Category H2H Each Category is the most common type of head-to-head play in fantasy baseball. It allows you to select the “X” number of statistical categories. For each scoring period, team totals are accumulated, and a win, loss, or tie is credited in each category based on the matchup results (i.e., 6-3-1 in a 10-category league). If selected, your league will have team schedules/playoffs, and you will have the option to set up divisions. NOTE: If the League Manager sets Home Team wins as a tiebreaker, the home team will win every tied category. #### Head-to-Head: Most Categories H2H Most Categories allows you to set “X” number of statistic categories. For each scoring period (usually Monday through Sunday), team totals are accumulated across each category. At the end of the scoring period, the winner is determined by which team wins the most categories. The end result is a win (1-0-0), loss (0-1-0), or tie (0-0-1). These results correspond directly to each team’s overall record. If selected, your league will have team schedules/playoffs, and you will have the option to set up divisions. #### Season Points Season Points scoring allows you to assign a point value to each statistical category (e.g., HR=4, RBI=1). Standings are based on the accumulation of points across all statistical categories and are combined into a single total points column. The team with the most overall points wins.

Scoring Settings

When creating a League Manager (LM) league, you can choose from many different scoring options. Our default settings will be pre-selected, and these can be edited by clicking on the “Scoring” link. On this page, all of the available stat categories and their corresponding point values can be edited to create your league’s unique scoring system. Edit Scoring Settings (Web Only) - In “League Manager” Leagues, the League Manager needs to click on the “LM Tools” tab. - Click on “Edit League Settings”. - Scroll down to the “Scoring” section and click  “Edit”. - You can edit any scoring for any stat group on the next page. Be sure to click “Submit Scoring Settings” when done. - ​If any settings are changed, the action will be listed in your league’s Transaction Log page.

NOTE: Scoring categories and their corresponding point values can be changed by the League Manager in a League Manager League at any time during the season. If either is changed after the season has begun, the system will automatically change all previous game results to match the changed settings.

Stat Corrections

It is possible that over the course of the fantasy hockey season some scoring plays and player statistics may be recorded incorrectly. If this happens:

  • The NHL official stat keepers review all collected stat data and make appropriate retroactive updates to the stats recorded on the day of the game. The deadline for all weekly scoring or stat corrections made by the system is the Saturday following the week of the game in question, during the season
  • Any changes entered in the system will automatically reflect in both your Box Score and your Standing’s pages

NOTE: In League Manager Leagues, if the league manager notices the incorrect scoring and uses the Adjust Scoring League Manager tool to manually change the score, and afterward the system updates automatically to reflect the same correction, the impacted team will be awarded with double credit for the correction. If this occurs, you should contact your league manager and ask them to re-adjust the scoring to remove the manual adjustment they entered. #### How to Adjust Scoring (Web Only): 1. League Managers can manually edit scores by clicking on the “Scoreboard” tab 2. Click “Adjust Scoring” under whichever matchup they wish to edit.

Team Manager Inactivity (LM Leagues)

The League Manager may contact the team managers of teams that remain inactive for extended periods. - The League Manager will send notifications to the email on record for the inactive team manager. - If the account still remains inactive after the email was sent by the League Manager, the League Manager reserves the right to reassign team managership of the inactive team.

Team Manager Invitation Issues (LM Leagues)

There are three common scenarios related to Team Manager issues:

No Invitation Received

If your League Manager claims to have sent you an invitation to the league, but you never received one in your inbox, there are a couple of potential reasons why: - Your League Manager could have entered your email address incorrectly. Double-check that they used your correct email address. - Your corporate or ISP’s firewall might potentially block emails from ESPN servers. We recommend that your League Manager use the “Send Me a Copy of Each Invite” option.

Once your League Manager receives the “cc’ed” email containing your team’s unique join URL, they can forward it to you from their personal email. #### Invitation Received but Unable to Join If you received the invitation from your League Manager, but the unique URL page says you can’t join the league, there is a potential reason why: - Your League Manager changed your email address after sending you the unique URL invitation, thereby nullifying and voiding the original invitation. Contact your League Manager to determine if this was the case.

Other Options Available

  • Speak to your League Manager about another email invitation; you can do this by removing and re-adding your email to the league.
  • Use an alternate email address, preferably one that is not work-related, such as Hotmail, Outlook, or Gmail.
  • Be sure to check your spam and junk folders, as it may have bounced in there by mistake. If that’s the case, add espnfantasy@fantasygames.com to your contact list.

Fair Play/Conduct: Impeding Other Team Managers

ESPN Fantasy Sports is a place for sports fans to have fun competing with each other while enjoying the sports we love. ESPN is committed to providing a fair and respectful experience for everyone. The following behaviors are examples of unacceptable behaviors. Please note this is NOT a comprehensive list. - Losing games solely to deny another team’s manager the chance to make the playoffs - Cycling through players in free agency to make them unavailable to other teams in your league - Collusive trading where one team obtains top-ranked players for bottom-ranked players in order to stack one team at the expense of another

Games Played Limits (Maximums)

In fantasy hockey, League Managers can set a maximum amount of games played during the season/H2H matchup. NOTE: If a team exceeds this value, it will continue to accrue stats for the rest of the day, but will NOT earn any skating/goalie stats the next day until the end of the matchup/season. 

For example, in a H2H league, if your league sets up like this:  (image: mceclip0.png) #### Scenario 1: At the conclusion of Saturday night’s game, you have 30 Skater games and 4 Goalie games completed. On Sunday, you can then play any numbers of skaters and goalies you like and exceed that amount. #### Scenario 2: At the conclusion of Thursday night’s game, you have 30 Skater games and 4 Goalie games completed.  You then proceed to play 2 Skater and 1 goalie on Friday.  After Friday’s games, you now have 32 Skaters and 5 Goalies.  In this case, you will NOT receive any points from any of your players on Saturday and Sunday since you exceeded the maximum prior to end-of-matchup. #### GAMES PLAYED LIMITS - GOALIE Enter a limit on the number of games a team may use in a given matchup. If a team exceeds this value, it will continue to accrue stats for the rest of the day, but will not earn any goaltending stats from players in goalie slots the next day until the end of the matchup. This value represents the limit for a standard matchup, which is 7 days in length. Longer or shorter matchups will have their limits scaled proportionally. By default, there are no limits on goalies. #### GAMES PLAYED LIMITS - SKATERS Enter a limit on the number of games a team may use in a given matchup. If a team exceeds this value, it will continue to accrue stats for the rest of the day, but will not earn any skating stats from players in skater slots the next day until the end of the matchup. This value represents the limit for a standard matchup, which is 7 days in length. Longer or shorter matchups will have their limits scaled proportionally. By default, there are no limits on skaters.

Lineup and Roster Lock Times

The Lock Time is when team lineups lock each week. This only applies to moving players between active slots, or between active slots and bench slots. Any moves involving trades, add/drops or IR moves will be locked at the first scheduled game of the day. There are two different types of “locks” – Lineup Lock and Roster Lock. Rosters (meaning the makeup of players on the team) are still locked at the start of the day or week as has always been the case. NOTE: In League Manager Leagues, the League Manager may change the Lineup Lock Time settings up until one hour prior to the draft. #### Below are the two options available in League Manager Leagues: - Lock Individually at Scheduled Game Time: This is the default setting and is used by the majority of leagues. If selected, team managers can make moves to their weekly rosters until the scheduled start of each player’s game. Only players whose games have started will be locked. The remaining players whose games have not started will remain unlocked and can be shifted. - Lock at First Game of the Week/Day: All roster moves will lock at the first game of the week, even if the first game falls on a Thursday. Once the first game starts for the scoring period, the entire roster is locked for the rest of the period and cannot be changed until the next scoring period.

Moving Players on and off of the Injured Reserve (IR) and Injury List (IL)

The system will automatically place the IR (injured reserve) or Injury List (IL) tag on a player once ESPN receives the league report. NOTE: Only players with the (IR), (IL), or (O) tag can be placed on the IR (injured reserve)/Injury List (IL) slot. All other players must be moved to the bench if you do NOT want them on the active roster. NOTE: IR/IL is available in all Standard leagues and only in League Managers that use IR/IL slot(s). If you don’t see the link, let your League Manager know they need to add this feature. - League Managers can enable IR/IL slots in a league by going under the LM Tools tab and selecting Edit League Settings.

  3. Tap To IR/IL to move the player into an open slot
  4. If you have no open slots, you will need to select a player to move from IR/IL by tapping on the Activate button.
  5. You will see a confirmation pop-up as this change is automatically saved.

Managing IR on ESPN.com

  1. Click on the Manage IR/IL link at the top of your team page a
  2. You will be shown a short list of IR/IL eligible players. Click on To IR/IL to place them in an available IR/IL slot. NOTE: If all of your IR/IL slots are occupied, you will need to Activate a player to make the change.

To move a player back from IR to your active roster, follow the same steps: 1. Click on the Manage IR/IL link at the top of your team page a 2. You will be shown a short list of players in your IR/IL. Click on Activate a player to move the player to your active roster.

Roster Adjustments After Players Have Locked

Why Are Some of My Players Locked?

Player slots lock individually as each NFL game kicks off — so if you left an injured player in an active slot and their game has already started, you won’t be able to swap them out for this week. Once a player’s slot is locked, only your League Manager (LM) can make roster changes on your behalf. This is how the LM keeps things fair and prevents any mid-game lineup adjustments that could give a team an unfair advantage. #### Roster Adjustment on the ESPN Fantasy App (LM Only) - Tap on “League Manager Tools” in the three stacked lines icon (AKA the ‘burger’).

  • Tap on “Edit Rosters” under the Roster Tools section.

  • Select the team to edit and move the player(s) as desired.

Roster Adjustment on the Web - ESPN.com (LM Only)

  • Click the “League Manager Tools” tab

  • Click “Edit Rosters” under the Roster Tools section

  • Select the team to edit and move the player(s) as desired.

Setting Your Lineup

Setting Your Lineup Overview

  • Decide which players to start for each day of competition
  • Your team page allows you to analyze each of your current players, review their performance (previous day/week, year to date, etc.), and freely move players between your active roster and bench
  • Roster moves involving a player may be made right up until that player’s team is scheduled to begin its game in that scoring period.
  • You must move one active player to the bench or to waivers when moving an inactive/benched player to your active lineup. If you make a move that violates a roster slot, an error message will appear, notifying you to double-check the proposed transaction. You will need to ensure that you are moving players into eligible slots per Position Eligibility
On the ESPN Fantasy App
  1. Go to your team’s homepage under Roster.
  2. Tap on the position button next to the player you wish to move. For example, BE for a player on your Bench.
  3. This will bring up a short list of eligible positions.
  4. ​Tap on the “Position” button next to the player you wish to swap positions with. Unless it is empty, just tap the slot.
  5. You will see a confirmation pop-up indicating that the move was automatically saved.
  6. PRO TIP: The ESPN Fantasy App also offers a “Quick Lineup” option.  This will allow you to automatically set your lineup for a single day or for the entire matchup.  This feature works by placing available players into their eligible slots if they have a game scheduled.  It will use the players’ rankings to determine which players are prioritized. This feature is exclusive to the ESPN Fantasy App.
On the Web
  1. Navigate to “My Team”
  2. ​Click on “Move” next to the player whom you wish to move within your lineup​
  3. Click the “Here” button next to the slot where you would like to move that player.  NOTE: As soon as you click “Here,” the change will be processed automatically. If you place the player into an empty slot, an empty slot will be created at that player’s previous position. ​A green confirmation banner will appear at the bottom of the page
